UObjectToolTips.FortQuestObjectiveClipboardData:
@brief Serializes quest objective data and components into JSON for clipboard storage.

This struct encapsulates quest objective data and its related extensions from quest item definition components.
When copying to the clipboard, it serializes the main objective data into a JSON object labeled "QuestObjective".
Then it iterates over each component in ObjectiveComponents, serializing each one into separate JSON object fields using
the class path of the component as the key. These serialized components are grouped together in a JSON object
labeled "QuestObjectiveExtensions". The resulting JSON string is then copied to the clipboard for storage.

When loading from the clipboard, it retrieves the JSON string and validates it. If valid, it deserializes
the main objective data from the "QuestObjective" field and each additional component from the
"QuestObjectiveExtensions" field. It constructs the Objective and ObjectiveComponents data structures
based on the deserialized data.

UObjectToolTips.FortMeshNetworkEventsLoader:
@class AFortMeshNetworkEventsLoader

The main goal of this actor is to provide an event dispatching mechanism for Fortnite and
the games built off of it. Phase 1 will be events defined in the component proper, but phase 2+
will incorporate a more general framework for event responding and communication that the game/plugins
future scripting initiatives/etc can interface with, and even a state machine defining phases
and actions within a phase (see: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1v-7PzLudd9QkAQ3Bi7B2KvQ3wbSlVYGlISTGPXXA1e0/edit?usp=sharing)

We will want to support multiple loaders that can also be tied to one/many playspace(s) that way events
can target multiple events on a single map.

There are 2 types of mesh network events that can be communicated to the Root Server that are then
disseminated out to the rest of the server/clients on the network.

MeshEventBurst - i.e. MeshNetEventBurst EventName
MeshEventStart/MeshEventEnd - i.e. MeshNetEventStart EventName and MeshNetEventEnd EventName

UObjectToolTips.FortHeldObjectComponent:
@class UFortHeldObjectComponent

      The held object component defines all the necessary functions/data to allow
      an object to become a held object. The component will implicitly grab a defined
      shape component (sphere, capsule, etc) and a defined projectile movement component. With
      these components it can handle implicitly being thrown, dropped, and placed.

      The component is setup with a generic held object weapon that defines an equip "pickup" animation,
      an ability to throw the object, and an ability to place the object. Drop happens via weapon switch, death,
      etc implicitly.

      @example: Attach this component to a BuildingGameplayActor. The BGA will override CanInteract
      and call the components CanInteract. If BGA can be held it will call OnInteract and call PickupHeldObject.

      @todo: For more fine control over pickup, placing, and throwing it would be nice to define anim
      notifies that can be assigned to an animation. Right now, attachment is done on pickup via on interact
      so it doesn't fully sync up with the weapon's equip anim. Throwing happens via a trigger event on the throw
      which looks great, but the detachment is happening via a timer, which isn't great.

UObjectToolTips.FortDownloadRequesterID:
A FFortDownloadRequesterID allows download handle retention pools, to disambiguate *unique sets* of handles under the same context.

ID's are specific to the caller, but must always represents a unique requester. The system is free to treat all requests under a given context
with a matching identifier to be treated as a separate bucket where pool settings allow.

Any single ID is not necessarily globally unique across different contexts  but should be unique within that context

The ID is implemented as a simple uint32 under the hood. FFortDownloadRequesterID offers a variety of methods to assist in
initializing this uint32  from integer, name (hashed), or gameplay tag (hashed from string), or object id depending on the requirements of the caller
UObjectToolTips.ManagerParticipantSubsetID:
A FManagerParticipantSubsetID allows a single manager implementing the QuestManager interface, to manage *multiple* unique sets of
participants to which quests can be granted, by assigning unique IDs to each subset.

ID's are context specific to any given manager, but always represents a unique group of participants that granted quests can be
scoped to within the scope of that single manager.

Any single ID is not necessarily globally unique across different managers ('1' could be widely used for example by multiple
managers to represent different participant subsets - 'squad 1' for a squad manager, or 'bounty event 1' in a bounty quest manager)

              oriented at 90 degrees relative to the current heading, then heading diff is

              from the target heading direction, and TargetRollPerHeadingDiff and the target
              heading diff magnitude are used to compute a blend parameter between control
              frame's up and the "full" roll angle.

UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaMutator_AI_SignificanceBasedUp:
A mutator used to optimize AI processing in Athena. If enabled, this mutator will batch and stagger the
tracked pawns' FortMovementComp_Character component updates so that not all components are being updated
on the same frame. The movement components are placed into buckets based on their pawn's significance. In
each bucket, movement components are divided evenly and randomly into groups (the number of groups in a
bucket equals it's FramesPerUpdate value). Only one group is updated per bucket per frame, so for a bucket
with FramesPerUpdate = 3, three groups will be created and the movement components in that bucket will be
spread evenly throughout them. Then the three groups will be updated on the next three frames (one per frame)
and the cycle will continue.

UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderAxisProjectionOperation: 单个轴投影操作：通过检查DriverBone是否在TargetBone的前面（或后面）沿AxisFrame的旋转定义的选定世界轴来限制姿势。适用于姿势条件，例如“左大腿在右大腿前面，相对于骨盆”：  DriverBone = thigh_l、TargetBone = thigh_r、AxisFrame = pelvis、Axis = X、bInvert = false。数学：  displacement = DriverBone_world.Pos - TargetBone_world.Pos  worldAxis    = AxisFrame_world.Rot * AxisLocal      （AxisLocal从Axis枚举中选择）  projected    = dot(displacement, worldAxis)         // 以cm为单位的有符号标量  if (bInvert) projected = -projected                 // 翻转以测试相反方向  output        = clamp((projected - RemapMin) / (RemapMax - RemapMin), 0, 1)输出是姿势乘以其骨骼产品的标准0..1斜坡。RemapMin/Max是带符号的cm阈值——bInvert在重映射之前翻转投影的符号，但负阈值也直接支持（例如RemapMin = -5、RemapMax = 0，当驱动器沿轴从后面接近目标时，斜坡为0→1）。
UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderDistanceOperation: 单个距离操作：通过DriverBone和ReferenceBone之间的世界距离来限制姿势。数学运算由模式选择（参见EPoseBuilderDistanceMode）。  RelativeToRestPose（旧版）：    标准化   = current_distance / RestDistance      // 参考处为0，静止处为1，静止后>1    ramp_input   = bInvert？normalized : (1 - normalized)  // default: closer = bigger    output       = clamp((ramp_input - RemapMin) / (RemapMax - RemapMin), 0, 1)  AbsoluteDistance (new):    signed_delta = current_distance - RestDistance      // +cm = further, -cm = closer    directional  = bInvert ? -signed_delta：signed_delta    output = clamp((directional - RemapMin) / (RemapMax - RemapMin), 0, 1)发布到UI的原始输出因模式而异：  - 相对模式：反转后的斜坡输入（`bInvert？`Normalized : 1-Normalized）— 输入到RemapMin/Max斜坡的值。用于根据运行时实际看到的内容调整重映射带。- 绝对模式：从静止状态开始的原始有符号厘米差值（`current_distance - RestDistance`），    预反转。显示真实物理运动方向，无论bInvert如何。这两种模式有意发布不同的量——相对模式是归一化的并与斜坡相关联，绝对模式是物理测量值（以厘米为单位）。
UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderReferenceOperation: 单个引用操作：不是真正的评估器——按名称查找之前计算的“公共”操作的姿势输出值。包装器FPoseBuilderOperation在Type==Reference上调度，并在运行时从WorkData.PublicOpValues读取。当消费者姿势从“添加操作”下拉菜单中选择一个公共操作名称时创建。在消费姿态上为只读（无扳手图标，无调试切换）。

UObjectToolTips.AthenaCapturePoint:
AAthenaCapturePoint
      This new building gameplay actor is the basis for all building based capture
      points.  The actor is setup to handle a plethora of capture point setups.

      Basic Rules: When a team (1+ players) steps on the capture point the point
      will flag which team is capturing and begin growing the percentage towards
      100%, when the point reaches 100% the point will lock for a defined set of
      time at which point it will unlock.

      CaptureStates: Idle is used when the point has no one on it but doesn't have
      the ability to return to 0. (Note: Useful when the decrease value is 0 to
      force the other team to drop it down to zero before gaining any control).
      Capturing is when a team is actively driving the percentage in their favor.
      Contested is when multiple teams are on the point forcing the point to contention
      based on the rules defined. Reseting is when the point has no one on it
      and has the ability to drive the percentage back to zero.

      Contention Rules: Currently there are two types of contention rules and it
      isn't hard to add more in the future. MajorityWins (default) is where the
      difference between multiple teams is the number of capturers and when an
      even number are present the point is in contention. (Note: This setup actually
      handles N teams where the team with the most and the team with the second
      most affect the difference, i.e. Team1 = 2, Team2 = 1, Team3 = 1 then Team1
      is capturing with a count of 1). OneTeamOnlyWins is where only 1 team can
      be present on the point at a time to actually capture it.

      Unlock Rules: Once the point is locked and the time interval is through and
      unlocks the point there are a couple of rules that govern how the point behaves.
      ResetState will remove the team that is controlling the point and reset all
      values to 0 so capturing can begin from the beginning again. MaintainState is
      used to keep the controlling team in ownership of the point at 100% so it is
      the other teams job to recapture the point back to 0 then back up to 100%.

UObjectToolTips.BuildingItemCollectorActor:
ABuildingItemCollectorActor

      The Building Item Collector Actor is a complex actor that can be used
      to build many different kinds of devices that players interact with
      and deposit items from their inventory.

      The Item Collector does not actually store actual inventory items. The
      actor simply verifies how many a player has, saves the total towards
      the deposit goal for that players team, then deletes those its from
      the players inventory.

      The Item Collector has various states (that may grow over time) such as FirstToGoal,
      FreeForAll.

      FirstToGoal - The objective of this behavior is for teams to deposit inventory items
      trying to be the first team to reach a desired goal value.
      When a team reaches the goal the Item Collector becomes "captured" and will no longer
      accept inventory drops until it is reset.

      Uses: BluGlo pylons in STW and Vending Machines in BR

A playspace can be bound only if it has a specific tag on itself, as defined with CustomRequiredTagForPlayspace (if not set uses the defaults: 'Playspace.Bindable')
Notes:
- this currently does not handle playspace removal nor if the actor moves (which could be implemented via PlayspaceComponent_SpatialActorTracker)
- actors might be bound to a playspace different from what they are spatially in, this can be an intended gameplay behaviour (ex. AIs bound to a playspace they are going to but are not yet in, or if they got launched out of physically)

UObjectToolTips.AthenaNavPresenceDetectorComponent:
ActorComponent that checks if one or more navigation data is/are available under the owner's location.

   It will initially broadcast NavMeshPresenceDetected or NavMeshPresenceDetected to tell if there is
   proper navigation data under owner's location (with bWasDetectedBefore/bWasUndetectedBefore = false).

   If a navigation data is not there, it will listen to newly computed nav tiles and if ever that navigation data
   become valid under the owner's location, we will broadcast the NavMeshPresenceDetected event once all the navigation data are detected (with bWasUndetectedBefore = true).

   If bDisableUponNavMeshPresence = false, if navigation data is present, it will continue listening to newly computed nav tiles and if ever the navigation data
   becomes INVALID under the owner's location, we will broadcast the NavMeshPresenceUndetected event (with bWasDetectedBefore = true).

   @note: if NavmeshNameToUse is None, it wills check against all existing AthenaNavMesh. See AthenaNavSystem.h for navmesh names to specific if needed.
   @note: if bDisableUponNavMeshPresence is True, the component Unregisters and so stops observing navigation data changes and will not refire the NavMeshPresenceDetected/NavMeshPresenceUndetected events.

UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderAimOperation: 瞄准操作 — 姿势驱动层的 CtrlRig `AimConstraint` 等效项。如何计算驱动器骨骼选择的局部轴与目标方向对齐，并且输出 [0,1] 个对齐值，该姿势可用作其激活 alpha。每次勾选的实时评估：AimDir   = normalize(TargetWorld.Location - AimBoneWorld.Location)  2. ActualDir = AimBoneWorld.Rotation.RotateVector(AimAxisLocal).Normalized()  3. Alignment = clamp((dot(ActualDir, AimDir) - InputMin) / (InputMax - InputMin), 0, 1)`imAxisLocal` 是 AimBone 上应指向目标的局部空间方向（典型惯例：UE 骨骼中指向前方的骨骼为 +X）。`inputMin/inputMax`将点积（-1.. 1 raw）重新映射到有意义的范围内 — 默认值为 " 垂直= 0，完全瞄准 = 1 "。镜像 `rigunit_aimConstraint_*` 减去轴向上的稳定度（仅影响装备-应用的旋转，而不是姿势驱动程序所需的对齐读数）。

Specify the denylist type entry, then set the playlist (or type) in the PlaylistKey member,

PlaylistNames are more specific, so take precedence over a similar entry for an event in a given playlist type.

UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaMutator_InventoryOverride_Buck:
An inventory override mutator that provides Cobalt-specific round-based loadout mechanics.
Loadouts are organized into buckets
Each round, a loadout is randomly selected for each bucket, which will be used by all players assigned to that bucket.
As long as there are at least as many buckets as players-per-team, no two players on the same team be assigned to the same bucket in a given round.
Player-bucket assignments are rotated each round so that as long as there are at least as many buckets as rounds, no player should get the same bucket twice.
Every team in given round has the same set of loadouts.

mutates its own list, at the one moment classification is guaranteed -- the client in

persistence exit, since no view source reliably resolves them at persist time.

UObjectToolTips.LootInjectionOptionRow:RarityUpgrades:
Array of rarity upgrades
Each entry in this array corresponds to what LTG is unlocked AND what weights should be used to decide what rarity to actually spawn.
The weights array of the highest unlocked rarity data will be used to determine which LTG is spawned. Each value in the weights array corresponds to lowest -> highest rarity.
If the weights array is left empty, the highest level rarity upgrade unlocked will always spawn.
Example:
BaseLootTierGroup = LTG_Weapon_Common -> This is used until the player has unlocked a higher rarity
RarityUpgrades =
LootTierGroup=LTG_Weapon_Rare, Weights={0.8, 0.2} -> once unlocked, the player has an 80% chance for LTG_Weapon_Common and a 20% chance for LTG_Weapon_Rare.
LootTierGroup=LTG_Weapon_Epic, Weights={0.7, 0.2, 0.1} -> once unlocked, the player has a 70% chance for LTG_Weapon_Common, 20% chance for LTG_Weapon_Rare, 10% chance for LTG_Weapon_Epic.
OR
RarityUpgrades =
LootTierGroup=LTG_Weapon_Rare, Weights={} -> once unlocked, the player will always receive LTG_Weapon_Rare from this loot option.
LootTierGroup=LTG_Weapon_Epic, Weights={} -> once unlocked, the player will always receive LTG_Weapon_Epic from this loot option.

UObjectToolTips.ValkyrieExperimentalSettingValues:
Base type for a FValkyrieExperimentalBaseSetting's per-project serialized values

Each FValkyrieExperimental*Setting declares a matching *Values struct whose UPROPERTYs are exactly the
setting's serialized fields, in the same declaration order, so the JSON emitted into the project file's
"dataSets.experimental" block stays byte-identical to what the setting struct itself produces today.
For values you don't want serialized, just leave them as non-UPROPERTY members.

FValkyrieExperimentalBaseSetting hold one concrete *Values instance per loaded project in a TMap<Project, FInstancedStruct>. The
FInstancedStruct carries the concrete UScriptStruct, and it is that reflection info - not this empty base -
that drives the generic JSON round-trip and property-grid binding. This base holds no data; it exists only
as the static type for a setting's typed value access.

UObjectToolTips.BuildingActor:CullDistance:
CLIENT: Determines the rendering distance for the actor's components.
SERVER: Passed down to the replication system, which will use it to determine the distance at which
this will be replicated to a remote client.

This is dynamically calculated by UpdateCullDistance based on size of the object, using data defined
on the world settings.

It exists so that nobody has to touch every asset made or being made, so smaller things will naturally
cull at smaller ranges vs. larger objects at further ranges.

NOTE: Intentionally non-transient because this is updated during OnConstruction, which does NOT get called
in cooked builds for statically-loaded actors, meaning this will be cached at cook time.

UObjectToolTips.EOratorRelevancyOverride:
Cheat-only override for the IsNetRelevantFor check applied to performance delivery.
Gates both the normal broadcast path (ForEachNetRelevantController) and the catch-up
eligibility check, so you can stage a "player out of earshot then walks in" flow
entirely through cheats: set ForceNotRelevant, start a performance with a non-None
CatchUpPolicy, then flip to ForceRelevant (or None) to have the catch-up poll deliver.
 - None: default; uses the real net relevancy result.
 - ForceNotRelevant: every controller fails the relevancy gate (suppresses both
   immediate delivery and catch-up).
 - ForceRelevant: every controller passes the relevancy gate (other gates still apply).
UObjectToolTips.EOratorCatchUpPolicyOverride:
Cheat-only override that forces a CatchUpPolicy at AddCatchUpEntry time, regardless
of the policy the caller supplied. Lets you exercise the catch-up paths in PIE without
modifying call sites that default to None.
 - NoOverride: default; honors the caller's policy.
 - ForcePolicyNone: force the performance to ignore catch-up recipients (suppresses entry insertion).
 - ForcePerformFromCurrent: force every performance to PerformFromCurrent.
 - ForcePerformFromStart: force every performance to PerformFromStart.

UObjectToolTips.SpecialEventMeshLeaderboardNetworkCompon:
Class that acts as a bridge between Leaderboard MeshNetwork dedicated servers and root server.
Properties can be replicated in the Actor [ASpecialEventMeshLeaderboardManager] from the Root all the way down to the clients.
RPCs though need to be configured in the component. Server RPCs will go up from dedicated servers to inner servers and up to the root server.

This class also reduces the number of requests made to the root server:
- Each Dedicated Server (Edge) and Intermediate Server (Inner) has an internal leaderboard of requests.
- Requests are not sent straightway. Each request is flushed after a RequestRate (seconds), collecting
 all requests from a single player in one request.
- If the request no longer meets the needed score in that time, then it's discarded.

UObjectToolTips.SpecialEventMeshLeaderboardManager:
Class that handles the Mesh Networking for a Global Leaderboard and a Local Leaderboard.
- In the Global Leaderboard it keeps track of the top [TopScorePlayersNum] scoring players in the world.
- In the Local Leaderboard it keeps track of all the players in the game session.

Features:
- It can be used both for HighScore leaderboards and LowScore leaderboards (like time attack) via ELeaderboardSortStrategy.
- Properties that are replicated in this class, will be replicated down from the Mesh Root, down to the Edge/Inner Servers and the clients.
- RPCs need to be handled via the LeaderboardMeshNetworkComponent so they can be sent up to the Root. That is used by Edge servers to send requests
 up to the root when a player scores.
- A Min Score [ScoreToEnterGlobalLeaderboard] is used to optimize the requests to the root.
- A request system is used via the LeaderboardMeshNetworkComponent, using a Request Rate, which is configurable. This way we optimize how many calls
 we sent up to the root in game modes where players can be constantly scoring. The higher the rate time, the more it takes the score to reach the root.
- Multiple properties are configurable via BP, via hotfix and via MeshCommand. This way we can do changes to the system even on Live day if needed.
- Anonymous players CAN'T reach the Leaderboard by design to follow privacy policies.

UObjectToolTips.AudioClusterAlgorithmTemplate_StaticSect:
Cluster related actors together in fixed sectors centered around the listener position. How this differs from the Dynamic Sector algorithm is
sectors here are fixed and don't depend on actor positions or the listener orientation. Actors are rather just categorized in one or the other
cluster based on which sector their position is in.

A sector is a portion of an "annulus" (a plane figure consisting of the area between a pair of concentric circles).
You will at most have N sectors, where N is the number of sectors dividing the 360deg annulus around the listener.

Sectors rotations are fixed. For example, for 4 sectors, you'll have 4 90deg sectors (because 360deg / 4 = 90deg). The first sector starting angle
can be customized.

Behavior blueprints can cast their ClusterData property to "Static Sector Audio Cluster Data" and read their cluster index that way.

Sectors positions don't rotate with the listener; they are just keeping their center aligned with it. For example, if your goal is to inform a 4.0
MetaSound based on how many actors are in each quadrant around the listener, use the UE.Spatialization MS Interface and pan your effects
accordingly.

The position of a cluster is thus that of the listener, offset radially at (OuterRadius - InnerRadius) / 2 in the direction of the half-width of
the sector. The offset from the listener is therefore fixed.
Note: This algorithm doesn't interpolate cluster positions between Fixed Updates, as it is not believed its position would be used to play a sound
directly over there. Reach out to AGE/TechAudio if you would need that!

Special cases supported:
- Single sector (ie, a 360deg annulus): Actors are part of the only cluster if their position is in the annulus.
- Disc sectors (ie, portions of a degenerate annulus where the inner circle is of radius 0): Actors are part of a sector if they are in range of
  the outer circle radius and in between the two angles defining the sector.
UObjectToolTips.AudioClusterAlgorithmTemplate_DynamicSec:
Cluster related actors together in sectors centered around the listener position. Properly supports moving actors. Allow multiple strategies for
choosing at which distance the "center" of a cluster is from the listener.
Better alternative to the legacy "Cone" algorithm.

A sector is a portion of an "annulus" (a plane figure consisting of the area between a pair of concentric circles).
The annulus starts after SectorMinRadius meters, and ends before SectorMaxRadius meters. It is then restricted to SectorWidth degrees. This gives
you a sector. Actors further than SectorMaxRadius or closer than SectorMinRadius are never clustered and are out of range for clustering.

When an actor is in range but fits no existing clusters, a new cluster is created for that actor alone, and that cluster's position is initialized
to that of the actor.

When an actor overlaps multiple clusters, it will always choose the one that's closest (excluding its current cluster IF the actor is alone in its
current cluster).

The cluster's position is such that its sector is oriented towards the geometric center of all actors it contains, at a distance from the listener
that's configurable (Center, Center weighted by actor distance, closest actor).

Clustering only happens during Fixed Updates (regularly spaced intervals, see FAudioClusterConfiguration::AlgorithmUpdateRateMs), meaning
OnActorAdded, OnStart, OnStop, OnSizeUpdated are only called at those intervals. This means that when an actor is spawned, some time might elapse
until it is properly added to a cluster. Same if an actor moves away from a cluster - its new cluster will be created at the next Fixed Update.

OnActorRemoved can be called at any time, as it happens directly when an actor is destroyed, or during the Fixed Update otherwise.

OnPositionUpdated can happen every Update (ie, every frame), as the algorithm will interpolate clusters current positions towards the target
position computed during the last Fixed Update.

UObjectToolTips.StateTreeManagerComponent:
Component responsible for creating, running, and possibly replicating StateTrees on Actors
There will only be one of these components on an Actor and will handle any/all StateTrees requested to run on the Actor

                                          ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
                                         | StateTreeManagerComponent |
                                          ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
               Single component attached to an Actor that will run all StateTrees for said Actor
                                                      |
                                                      |
                     -------------------------------- |---------------------------------
                     |                                |                                |
          ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~          ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~          ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
            | FStateTreeRuntimeData |        | FStateTreeRuntimeData |        | FStateTreeRuntimeData |
          ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~          ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~          ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Structures containing the runtime data required to run a UStateTreeExecutionContext (brains of the state machine)
                         and optionally replicate the state transitions to clients
                     |                                |                                |
                     |                                |                                |
                        \                             |                             /
                           \                          |                          /
                              \                       |                       /
                                 \                    |                    /
                                    \                 |                 /
                                       \              |              /
                                          \           |           /
                                             \        |        /
                                                \     |     /
                                                   \  |  /
                                                     \|/
                                           ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
                                          | FStateChangeDataArray |
                                           ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
     Single FastArray replicating all state changes/transitions for all StateTrees that want to replicate.
  These StateChanges will be put into their respective client-side simulation and sorted in transition order.
                                                      |
                                                     /|\
                                                   /  |  \
                                                /     |     \
                                             /        |        \
                                          /           |           \
                                       /              |              \
                                    /                 |                 \
                                 /                    |                    \
                              /                       |                       \
                           /                          |                          \
                        /                             |                             \
                     |                                |                                |
  ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~     ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~     ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
 | FStateTreeClientSimulationData |   | FStateTreeClientSimulationData |   | FStateTreeClientSimulationData |
  ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~     ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~     ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Each FStateTreeRuntimeData that wants to replicate to clients will have a matching FStateTreeClientSimulationData.
The FStateChangeDataArray communicates the transitions from the FStateTreeRuntimeData to the respective
FStateTreeClientSimulationData. These transitions are queued up, wait for the associated UStateTreeTaskObjects to
replicate, and simulates the transition in the same order it happened in the FStateTreeRuntimeData's StateTree.

NOTE: UStateTreeTaskObjects is where the gameplay logic lives and are separately replicated subobjects who
themselves likely have replicated variables. These subobjects are referenced in the FStateChangeData and can't
be assumed to arrive at the same time that the transition made its way through this system; hence the queuing system.

NOTE: UStateTreeTaskObjects may never make their way to the client if the server began and ended the state it's
associated with before it could replicate to the client. In this situation, this replicated transition system will
skip that transition altogether and move forward to the next transition.

UObjectToolTips.MeshNetworkComponent:
Component that can be added to Actors in order to allow them to Receive properties from the Mesh Network
and to Send RPCs to the Mesh Network.

When added to an Actor, all of the Actors replicated properties will be replicated through the Mesh.
However, any RPCs on the Actor will behave as if no mesh was present (Server only goes to the Game Server,
Client only goes to the specific client, and Multicast only goes to clients connected to the Game
server).

Properties on the MeshNetworkComponet will be replicated alongside Actor Properties, just like standard replication.
But, MeshNetworkComponents only support Server and Multicast RPCs. Server RPCs go up through the Mesh
(and may be aggregated) and Multicast RPCs go down through the mesh to all clients. There is no notion
of (single) Client RPCs on the MeshNetworkComponent.

UObjectToolTips.FortAISmartObjectUserComponent:
Component that can be added to a AI pawn to have them use SmartObjects.
Replicated but only 'GetRunningSmartObject' works on clients!
The user flow is the following (plus extra optional steps):
- RunEvaluation
-- Register to internal FFortSmartObjectEvaluationResult delegates
- Call BeginSmartObjectBehavior when the AI enters the bhv scope, and so is starting to actively using the bhv [activation]
- Move to slot
- Call BeginSmartObjectInteraction when the AI is at the slot and ready to interact with the SO [running]
- Call EndSmartObjectInteraction when the AI is done interacting with the SO [end running]
- Call EndSmartObjectBehavior when the AI exits the bhv scope, and so is changing their bhv [end activation]

UObjectToolTips.FortInputBasedAFKComponent:
Component that determines whether or not a player is Away From Keyboard.

There are four "AFK States" that a player might be in:
 - Not AFK: The player is interacting with the game frequently enough that they are not considered AFK.
 - Suspected AFK: The player hasn't interacted with the game for a short time, so we start watching for signs that will prove they're not AFK.
 - Confirmed AFK: The player hasn't interacted with the game for a long time, so they are considered AFK.
 - Remained AFK: The player has been confirmed AFK for some time.

Interacting with the game in some detectable way will reset the state to "Not AFK."

UObjectToolTips.CosmeticDataComponent:
Component used to track individual cosmetic properties of an arbitrary type based on the actor's equipped cosmetics.

Properties are broken up into buckets based on the slot tag (for instance, a character could have a
CosmeticSlot.Backpack and CosmeticSlot.Outfit) and have property tags (such as CosmeticProperty.BackpackColor1
and CosmeticProperty.OutfitColor2).

Properties can be of any type that is derived from FCosmeticPropertyBase so plugins can easily inject new properties.

Only one property with a given type or tag can be present in a bucket at a time. If a new property with matching
type and tag is added, that property will override the existing value.

UObjectToolTips.ConditionalTransitionComponent:
Conditional Transition Component
This Game Framework Component can be added onto any Actor to provide support for the actor being in various phases
Phases are defined by Targeted reactions that are granted when the phase is entered, and Conditionals that when met will
process going to a new phase for the instigator.
Phases exist on server and client, but conditional transitions are only triggered on server, and the new phase name from the transition is replicated
to client, where the client will process the transition for the new phase as well.

UObjectToolTips.FortControllerComponent_ArcadeMinigame:
Controller-attached component that manages a single player's arcade-game session.

  Server side:
    - Observes pawn death (via UFortControllerComponent::OnPawnDied) so dying
      mid-arcade ends the session cleanly.
    - Observes AFortPawn::OnDBNOStateChanged so going DBNO mid-arcade ends the
      session cleanly too, same as death.

  Client side (via RPC):
    - Pushes a UDynamicUIScene to the UDynamicUIManager for the local player.
    - Pushes a UInputMappingContext + binds the exit input action.

The scene declares the widget(s) to display via its Allowed list; this component
never instantiates widgets directly.

Cabinet BGAs hold a UDynamicUIScene reference. On BlueprintOnInteract they call
GetForPlayer(InteractingPC)->BeginSession(Scene).

NOTE: Currently the triggers that we have for vehicle refueling are not necessarily continuous, so we can't always
precisely determine whether the vehicle stopped refueling.

e.g., the gas pump relies on FortProjectilePetrol, which refuels vehicles that are hit.

For this reason, we're calling this whenever the vehicle stops receiving OnRefuelStart events for longer than X seconds.

UObjectToolTips.DigestedWeaponAccuracy:LoFEnableDistance:
Determines whether or not distance validation from the querying bot for any potential LoF-blocking hit should be enabled.
 - If negative, do NOT override settings in UAthenaAIServiceLOF
 - If ZERO, disable hit distance validation from the querying bot (ie, always consider LoF valid regardless of where the hit occurred)
 - If positive, enable hit distance validation from the querying bot
Refer to UAthenaAIServiceLOF for more info.

 - If positive, enable hit distance validation from the querying bot

 - If positive, enable hit distance validation from the target
Refer to UAthenaAIServiceLOF for more info.
UObjectToolTips.WeaponAccuracy:LoFEnableDistanceToTarget:

 - If negative, do NOT override settings in UAthenaAIServiceLOF

 - If positive, enable hit distance validation from the target
Refer to UAthenaAIServiceLOF for more info.

UObjectToolTips.PlayspaceComponent_DormancyManager:
Dormancy Manager component for Playspaces

This component will automatically handle the dormancy of its containing Playspace based on the amount of users within that Playspace.

When there are no users in the Playspace, that Playspace will be network dormant. When any users enter the Playspace, that Playspace will leave
network dormancy. (Although, the specific dormancy states are user-controlled via properties)

Use cases include:
Default: Initial = DORM_Initial, Awoken = DORM_Awake, Asleep = DORM_DormantAll  - (as described above)

Selectively Awoken: Initial = DORM_Initial, Awoken = DORM_DormantPartial, Asleep = DORM_DormantAll
    - When awoken, still dormant for some connections

Selectively Asleep:  Initial = DORM_DormantPartial, Awoken = DORM_Awake, Asleep = DORM_DormantPartial
 - While asleep, still non-dormant for some connections

UObjectToolTips.MultiNavigationDensityVolume:
Editor-paintable volume that overrides cross-mesh transition density inside the
multi-navmesh generator. Drop one into a level and tune TransitionSpacingUU to
densify (smaller) or sparsen (larger) cross-mesh links wherever the volume
overlaps a candidate transition's projected location on either sub-navmesh.

Resolution rule (in the generator's SampleColumn): if either side's projection
lies inside this volume's brush, the volume's TransitionSpacingUU replaces the
multi-nav's global MinTransitionSpacingUU. When multiple volumes contain a
sample, or both sides land in different volumes, the smallest (densest) value
wins. Build-time only — runtime moves of the volume don't auto-rebuild.

UObjectToolTips.FortComponent_Energy:NewActiveEnergyChan:
Energy channels that have just been added this frame.  They are guaranteed to last at least one frame, and won't
be removed until they've acted.  NOTE: Currently only EnergyChannels that are USING energy, not ADDING energy,
are put in this array.  That's because we want to guarantee we don't add and then remove in the same frame and
so dodge the energy use, but at the moment we're not concerned with exploits dodging the addition of energy.
If some use-case arises where it is an exploit to dodge adding energy, we can add those through this intermediary
as well.

UObjectToolTips.RigUnit_PoseBuilder: 评估UPoseBuilderAsset与当前绑定状态的对比。每帧管线（请参阅RigUnit_PoseBuilder.cpp中的Execute()）：  1. 缓存验证。当骨骼计数、姿势顺序（ReorderVersion）或任何引用的骨骼键发生变化（LastBoneKeyHash）时，驱动器、被驱动骨骼、DeltaRef基础、父骨骼和曲线的平面索引FCachedRigElement数组将被重建。2. 每姿势驱动器评估。每个驱动器运行SPR椭圆数学（DriverMode::SPR）或     DeltaRef组件提取（DriverMode::DeltaRef），所有姿势的驱动器权重的AND积成为该姿势的激活。可选的FInterpTo平滑     可以通过bAlphaInterpEnabled应用。PoseWeight（或其绑定的CR变量）用作最终输出乘数；绑定到FALSE的布尔变量会短路整个姿势以提高性能。编辑驱动骨骼隔离还会短路所有     未编辑的姿势。3. 统一混合通道。被驱动骨骼（默认模式=存储偏移，ParentConstraint     模式=加权父级混合）在静止变换基线上进行混合。姿势按优先级升序处理，因此高优先级姿势会覆盖     共享骨骼上的低优先级贡献。4. 曲线回写。每个姿势的DrivenCurves被设为该姿势的激活权重，     并跳过禁用/编辑模式的姿势（完全不写入曲线，因此驱动相同曲线的其他系统不会发生冲突）。  5. 调试绘制。用于眼睛按钮驱动器、混合激活驱动器和     激活的驱动骨骼编辑模式驱动器的SPR流形。流形通过DriverActivationWeights进行筛选，因此只     绘制实际在其激活区域内的驱动器。UPoseBuilderAsset上的仅编辑器状态（EditModePoseSlot加上EditorState.ActiveEdit，用于四个互斥的子编辑模式）控制评估路径，因此绑定单元和细节面板协同工作，而不会争夺预览变换。

UObjectToolTips.FortWorldConditionStateComponent: 评估由数据注册表驱动的世界状况查询，应用游戏标签 + 触发 BP 事件当条件结果发生变化时。支持两种类型的检查（两者可以同时激活）：-仅限Actor：每次勾选一次评估，仅以所有者Actor作为上下文。-每个附近行动者：根据附近Actor的每一次tick进行评估。使用 UFortNearbyActorsPerceptionComponent 组件 在所有者身上侦测附近的Actor。感知配置默认为真实玩家，但可以是 在编辑器中进行了更改。数据注册表中的每一行都有一个可选的选择前置条件，该条件会在每个tick中重新评估，直到通过，然后永久激活。这种延迟激活处理ASC或标签在生成时未准备好的情况。它还允许单个共享数据表为许多不同的Actor提供服务，并进行逐行筛选。注意：要对每个附近的Actor进行评估，此组件需要自有上的ActorufortNearbyActorsPerceptionComponent。如果Actor是 AI/NPC pawn，请改用 UFortAINearbyActorsPerceptionComponent（提供 AI LOD 集成）。如果缺失，该组件将确保在 BeginPlay 上运行。

UObjectToolTips.FortEventReaction_ModifyTagContainer:
FFortEventReaction_ModifyTagContainer

通过添加、移除、设置或清除标签来修改标签容器全局变量的事件反应。标签容器操作：
此反应在标签容器变量上提供完整的CRUD操作：
- **添加**：将标签插入现有容器（ 并集操作）
- **移除**：从容器中删除特定标签（差分操作）
- **设置**：替换整个容器内容（赋值操作）
- **清除**：清空容器（复位操作）

常见用例：
- **增益系统**：添加/移除增益标签（“Buff.Strength”、“Buff.Speed”）
- **状态效果**：追踪激活效果（“Status.Burning”、“Status.Frozen”）
- **权限系统**：授予/撤销权限（“Permission.Build”、“Permission.Admin”）
- **解锁系统**：添加已解锁内容标签（“Unlocked.Weapon.Rifle”、“Unlocked.Ability.Dash”）
- **任务系统**：追踪已完成目标（“Quest.Objective.1”、“Quest.Objective.2”)
- **状态追踪**：监控激活状态（“State.InCombat”、“State.Sprinting”)

场景示例：
- **授予增益**：Operation=Add，Tags={"Buff.Damage.10Percent"}
- **移除减益**：Operation=Remove，Tags={"Debuff.Slowed"}
- **设置权限**：Operation=Set，Tags={"Permission.Build", "Permission.Edit"}
- **清除所有增益**：Operation=Clear（忽略TagsToModify）
- **添加多个状态**：Operation=Add，Tags={"Status.Poison", "Status.Weakened"}
- **解锁技能**：Operation=Add，Tags={"Ability.Dash", "Ability.DoubleJump"}

存储范围：
变量可以限定在不同的存储级别：
- 世界范围：全局共享（例如世界事件、全局解锁）
- Actor范围：每个Actor（例如角色增益、玩家权限）
- 关卡实例范围：在关卡实例内共享

操作详情：

**添加操作：**
- 将标签添加到现有集合中
- 重复标签会自动忽略（集合不允许重复）
- 如果容器不存在，则用这些标签创建容器
- 示例：容器有{A, B}，添加{B, C}→结果：{A, B, C}

**移除操作：**
- 移除特定标签（如有）
- 容器中不存在的标签会被静默忽略
- 如果容器不存在，则不执行任何操作
- 示例：容器有{A, B, C}，移除{B, D}→结果：{A, C}

**设置操作：**
- 完全替换容器内容
- 丢弃所有之前的标签
- 如果容器不存在，则用这些标签创建容器
- 示例：容器有{A, B, C}，设置{D, E}→结果：{D, E}

**清除操作：**
- 移除所有标签，创建一个空容器
- 此操作不使用TagsToModify
- 如果容器不存在，则创建空容器
- 示例：容器有{A, B, C}，清除→结果：{}

集成：
可使用以下方法查询修改后的标签容器：
- FGameplayProviderTagContainer_GlobalVariable，用于检索容器
- 标签查询，用于检查特定标签或模式
- HasTag/HasAny/HasAll操作，用于条件逻辑

@see 有关此反应修改的变量类型，参见FGlobalVariableType_TagContainer
@see 有关标签容器的读取，参见FGameplayProviderTagContainer_GlobalVariable
@see 有关容器查询，参见GlobalVariableUtils::GetGlobalVariableTagContainer

FFortEventReaction_UpdateInt32Variable

基于触发条件的差量值更新一个int32全局变量的事件反应。行为：
- 从触发条件中提取差量（FGameplayConditionalReactionData）
- 将差量转换为int32（截断小数部分）
-（可选）乘以数值提供器值
- 将最终值添加到int32全局变量

差量来源：
差量来源于触发此反应的条件。条件追踪
其测量值的变化（例如生命值降低25，分数增加100）。该反应将该差量应用于不同的变量。用例：
- 伤害追踪：当生命值降低时，将伤害量添加到TotalDamageTaken中
- 分数累积：获得积分时，添加到生涯总分中
- 击杀追踪：当敌人数量减少时，增加EnemiesDefeated
- 资源消耗：消耗弹药时，追踪AmmoExpended总量
- 进度里程碑：当目标完成后，增加TotalCompletedObjectives

示例场景：
- 生命值伤害：条件监控生命值，当生命值降低时，将差量添加到DamageTaken变量中
- 获得积分：条件监控分数，当分数增加时，将差量添加到LifetimePoints中
- 连击计数器：条件检查连击数，当连击数增加时，将差量添加到ComboTotal中
- 资源消耗：条件监控金币，当金币减少时，将差量添加到的GoldSpent中
- 敌人进度：条件监控EnemiesRemaining，当其减少时，增加EnemiesKilled

乘数：
可选的乘数允许在应用差量前缩放差量：
- 难度乘数：将伤害乘以难度乘数
- 奖励乘数：在奖励期间应用2倍乘数
- 团队分配：按队伍规模分配积分（使用小于1的分数）
- 缩放：应用百分比修改器

乘数示例：
- buseMultiplier=true，乘数=2.0→ 差量10变成20
- buseMultiplier=True，乘数 = 0.5 → 差量10变成5
- buseMultiplier=True，来自DifficultyLevel变量的乘数 → 动态缩放

转换：
差量和乘数均转换为int32：
- 差量25.7 → 25（截断）
- 差量10.0 *乘数1.5 = 15.0 → 15
- 直接丢弃小数部分（不四舍五入）

UObjectToolTips.FortEventReaction_UpdateNumericVariable:
FFortEventReaction_UpdateNumericVariable

根据触发条件的差量更新数值型（双精度）全局变量的事件反应。行为：
- 从触发条件（FGameplayConditionalReactionData）中提取差量
- 差量为双精度值（保留小数精度）
- （可选）乘以数值提供器值
- 将最终值添加到数值型全局变量中

数字与Int32：
此反应作用于FGlobalVariableType_Numeric（双精度浮点）变量。在以下场景中，应使用此项而非UpdateInt32Variable：
- 小数值和精度（百分比、乘数、比率）
- 超出int32限制的大值范围
- 微小变化的平滑累积
- 需要小数精度的数学运算

差量来源：
差量来源于触发此反应的条件。条件追踪
其测量值的变化（例如生命值百分比减少0.25，速度乘数
增加0.1）。该反应将该差量应用于不同的变量。用例：
- 百分比追踪：追踪累积百分比变化
- 乘数累积：逐步添加增益乘数
- 比率计算：累积比率和速度
- 精确指标：追踪包含小数的精确伤害量
- 平滑进度：逐步增加属性（每帧0.01）
- 金融系统：带小数位的货币

场景示例：
- 增益叠加：条件追踪增益强度，将差量添加到TotalBuffMultiplier
- 体力消耗：条件监控体力比率，将消耗量添加到TotalStaminaUsed
- 精确伤害：追踪精确伤害量，包括小数（25.75伤害）
- 速度累积：追踪应用的总速度奖励（0.15 + 0.25 + 0.1）
- 任务进度：累积部分进度百分比（0.33 + 0.67 = 1.0）乘数：
可选的乘数允许在应用差量前缩放差量：
- 效率修改器：将资源使用量乘以效率（0.8 = 效率提高20%）
- 奖励乘数：在事件期间应用1.5倍乘数
- 缩放系数：应用百分比修改器（0.25表示减少25%）
- 动态调整：基于当前游戏状态进行缩放

乘数示例：
- bUseMultiplier=true, 乘数=2.0→ 差量0.5变为1.0
- bUseMultiplier=true, 乘数=0.75→ 差量1.0变为0.75
- bUseMultiplier=true，来自EventBonus变量的乘数→动态缩放

精度：
差量和乘数都保留完整的双精度：
- 差量0.125 * 乘数1.5 = 0.1875（精确）
- 无截断或舍入损失
- 适用于累积许多微小变化

UObjectToolTips.FortMoveCollisionProbeSetup:
FFortMoveCollisionProbeSetup are used to check outside of the main collision Capsule of the character, to determine if there are
undesirable penetrations on parts of the body that extend outside of that capsule. The actual Probe should be added
as a PrimitiveComponent with a named tag, matching the ProbeTag entry on this setup.
 * The probe will be swept every other frame (or with an optional DelayBetweenProbes delay)
 * The probe is swept from the Actor root to the component location on the Actor, vs ProbeSweepTypes object types.
 * Any blocking collision found is applied to our movement as an additional InputVector away from the collision.
 * The strength of that input is the penetration depth along the sweep, times AvoidanceStrength (scales up the more it penetrates).

UObjectToolTips.FortRichFoleyCacheKeyExclusion:

UObjectToolTips.FortRichFoleyChooserData:
FFortRichFoleyChooserData - Snapshot of the runtime inputs that drive rich foley chooser evaluation.
Two snapshots compare equal when the choosers would produce the same result, letting Play_Implementation
reuse the cached chooser result.

NOTE: if adding a parameter to this struct make sure to update the == operator and CompareRichFoleyChooserDataForCache
UObjectToolTips.FortRichFoleyContextCacheEntry:
FFortRichFoleyContextCacheEntry - Per-EventTag cache slot for UFortPlayerRichFoleyContext.
Stores the runtime-data snapshot (cache key) together with the chooser result it produced —
the resolved wave container plus its attenuation/concurrency. On a cache hit the entry is
re-stamped onto PlaybackSettings and a fresh one-shot is fired, skipping chooser evaluation
and the async load entirely (the foley sounds are one-shots, so there is no long-lived
component worth keeping resident — see UFortPlayerRichFoleyContext::ApplyCachedEventData).

FGameplayProviderNumerical_GlobalVariable_Int32

数值提供器，从全局变量中检索一个int32值并将其转换为双精度值。行为：
- 如果变量存在：返回转换为双精度值的int32值（精确保留数值）
- 如果变量不存在：返回备用提供器值（若已配置），或空的可选值

类型转换：
该提供器读取FGlobalVariableType_Int32变量，并将其转换为双精度值
以用于数值计算。int32值的转换是无损的，因为双精度值可以
精确表示所有32位整数。存储范围：
变量可以限定在不同的存储级别：
- 世界范围：在整个世界/关卡中共享
- Actor范围：特定于单个Actor
- 关卡实例范围：在关卡实例内共享
范围决定了变量的存储和检索位置。用例：
- 读取计数器：killCount、CollectedItems、CompletedObjects
- 查询分数：CurrentScore、HighScore、TotalPoints
- 检查进度：CurrentLevel、WaveNumber、RemainingLives
- 条件：用于数学运算或比较（例如：如果分数 > 1000）
- 动态计算：乘以DamageBase * DifficultyLevel

示例场景：
- 奖励发放：计算BonusPoints = BaseReward *（killCount/10）
- 缩放难度：SpawnRate = BaseRate + (WaveNumber * 2)
- 进度解锁：CollectedKeys > = RequiredKeys时解锁门
- 动态定价：Cost = BasePrice + (PurchaseCount * 10)

备用值：
如果变量不存在且bUseBackupValueIfVariableDoesntExist为true，
改为评估BackupValue提供器。这允许在变量尚未初始化时
使用默认值或回退计算。@see 有关该提供者读取的变量类型，参见FGlobalVariableType_Int32
@see 有关基础数值提供器接口，参见FGameplayProviderNumerical
@see 有关底层查找函数，参见GlobalVariableUtils:: getGlobalVariableInt32

UObjectToolTips.GameplayQuery_BoolGlobalVariable:
FGameplayQuery_BoolGlobalVariable

检查布尔全局变量是否与预期值匹配的查询。查询结果：
- 如果变量值==bExpectedValue，则返回**通过**
- 如果变量值!= bExpectedValue，则返回**失败**
- 如果变量不存在：使用bTreatMissingVariableAs进行比较

行为示例：
- 变量=true，预期=true→**通过**
- 变量=false，预期=true→**失败**
- 变量=true，预期=false→**失败**
- 变量=false，预期=false→**通过**
- 变量不存在，TreatMissingAs=false，预期=false→**通过**
- 变量不存在，TreatMissingAs=false，预期=true→**失败**

存储范围：
变量可以限定在不同的存储级别：
- 世界范围：在整个世界/关卡中共享
- Actor范围：特定于单个Actor（需要参与者对象）
- 关卡实例范围：在关卡实例中共享

用例：
- 功能门检查：在允许操作之前查询“FeatureEnabled”是否为true
- 状态验证：检查“IsDoorOpen”是否为true以允许通过
- 要求检查：验证“HasCompletedTutorial”是否为true以使用高级功能
- 否定检查：查询“IsLocked”是否为false（使用bExpectedValue = false）
- 条件逻辑：基于全局布尔标记的分支行为
- 系统切换：检查调试模式或管理模式是否启用

场景示例：
- 任务门控：在显示目标之前检查“Quest.IsActive”是否为true
- 门交互：查询“Door.IsUnlocked”是否为true以允许打开
- 跳过教程：检查“Player.HasSeenTutorial”是否为true以跳过介绍
- 功能标记：查询“Features.NewCombatSystem”是否为true以启用新机制
- 管理操作：检查“Player.IsAdmin”是否为true以执行管理命令
- 否定条件：查询“World.GameOver”是否为false以继续游戏

缺失变量处理：
bTreatMissingVariableAs属性为未初始化变量提供优雅的处理：
- 设为false（默认）：缺失变量被视为false（安全默认值）
- 设为true：缺失变量被视为true（选择加入行为）
- 这允许查询在变量被显式初始化之前正常工作

常见模式：
- 检查为true：预期=true，TreatMissing=false（需要显式true）
- 检查为false：预期=false，TreatMissing=false（默认视为false）
- 选择退出标记：预期=false，TreatMissing=true（必须显式设为false）
- 选择加入标记：预期=true，TreatMissing=false（必须显式设为true）

集成：
此查询可用于：
- FGlobalVariableModifier_LogicalOperation（作为操作数查询）
- 条件反应和修改器
- Gameplay技能要求
- 状态机条件
- UI可见性规则

@see 有关此查询读取的变量类型，参加FGlobalVariableType_Bool
@see 有关基础查询接口，参见FGameplayQuery
@see 有关底层查找函数，参见GlobalVariableUtils::GetGlobalVariableBool
UObjectToolTips.GameplayQuery_DistanceInRange:
FGameplayQuery_DistanceInRange检查上下文对象和查询对象之间的距离是否在指定范围内。两个对象都使用标准解析链解析为其最佳位置Actor：
APawn > AActor > UActorComponent所有者（递归）。这样可以确保控制器、玩家状态、并且组件可以正确地解析给具有有效世界位置的Actor。查询结果：-当两个已解析的Actor之间的距离在 DistanceRange 之内时，返回 **Passed**-当距离超出 DistanceRange 时返回 **失败**-当任一对象无法解析为有效Actor时，返回 **失败**距离模式：-3D 距离（默认）：包括垂直间隔在内的全欧几里得距离-2D 距离：仅水平距离，忽略 Z 轴，适用于地面检查用例：-近距离触发器：检查玩家距离目标是否在 500 个单位以内-攻击距离验证：验证目标是否在武器有效范围内-互动距离：确认玩家距离足够近，可以与物体互动-安全区检查：确定Actor是否在距离范围内（例如，介于 200 到 1000 个单位之间）-AI 意识：检查 AI 是否应该注意到附近的玩家示例场景：-DistanceRange = [0, 500]，bUse2DDistance = false-> 如果在 3D 模式下在 500 个单位以内，则通过-DistanceRange = (1000, +inf)，bUse2DDistance  = true-> 如果水平距离超过 1000 个单位，则通过-DistanceRange = [200, 800]-> 如果介于 200 到 800 个单位（含）之间则通过@参见 GameplayQueryUtilities::ResolveLocationActor 用于Actor解析链@参见FGameplayQuery_IsNumericalValueInRange 用于通用数值范围检查@参见 FGameplayQuery_IsFacing 用于定向空间检查
UObjectToolTips.GameplayQuery_IsFacing:
FGameplayQuery_IsFacing

检查上下文对象是否在指定角度锥内面向查询对象。朝向检查计算上下文Actor的前向向量与
查询Actor的方向之间的角度。如果该角度在AngleTolerance的度数范围内，
则查询通过。两个对象都使用标准解析链解析为其最佳位置Actor：
APawn > AActor > UActorComponent所有者（递归）。查询结果：
- 当上下文Actor的前向向量与查询Actor的方向之间的角度
小于或等于AngleTolerance时，返回**通过**
- 当角度超过AngleTolerance时，返回**失败**
- 当两个对象都无法解析为有效Actor时，返回**失败**
- 当两个Actor位于同一位置时（方向为零），返回**失败**

角度模式：
- 2D角度（默认）：忽略垂直（Z）分量，仅检查水平朝向
- 3D角度：包括俯仰在内的完整3D角度，适用于飞行或垂直瞄准检查

用例：
- 检测系统：检查AI是否正在看向玩家
- 潜行机制：验证玩家不在敌人的视线锥中
- 交互验证：确保玩家正对着可交互对象
- 辅助瞄准：确定玩家是否大致瞄准目标
- 背刺机制：反转查询以检查攻击者是否在目标后面

示例场景：
- AngleTolerance = 45，bUse2DAngle = true -> 如果水平朝向在45度以内，则通过
- AngleTolerance = 90，bUse2DAngle = true -> 如果目标在前半球中，则通过
- AngleTolerance = 10，bUse2DAngle = false -> 紧密3D锥体，适用于精确瞄准
- AngleTolerance = 180 -> 始终通过（完整球体）

@see 有关Actor解析链，参见GameplayQueryUtilities::ResolveLocationActor

UObjectToolTips.GameplayQuery_IsObjectiveActive: FGameplayQuery_IsObjectiveActive检查查询对象的特定任务目标当前是否处于活动状态。在查询对象上查找指定的任务并检查命名目标是否为当前处于活动状态（进行中）。查询对象直接传递给任务工具——它不一定是Actor。支持任何拥有任务的对象（玩家、游戏状态、NPC 或任何实现任务参与者界面的对象）。任务定义在编辑器中选择，目标从下拉列表中选择通过自定义属性类型从该任务的目标中填充。查询结果：-当任务中的指定目标对查询对象处于活动状态时返回 **Passed**-当目标未激活（未开始、未完成或未找到任务）时，返回 **失败**-当查询对象为空时返回 **失败**-未设置任务定义或未加载任务定义时返回 **失败**-未设置目标后端名称时返回 **失败**用例：-任务门控：仅允许在特定目标进行时采取行动-目标驱动的事件：当目标成为活动步骤时触发反应-有条件的用户界面：根据当前任务进度显示或隐藏界面元素-NPC 行为：根据玩家的主动目标更改 NPC 对话或动作@参见 FGameplayConditional_QuestState 用于事件驱动的任务状态监控@参见 QuestUtilities::FindQuestFromDefinition 任务查找机制的定义
UObjectToolTips.GameplayQuery_NearbyActorsOfType: FGameplayQuery_NearbyActorsOfType检查与上下文对象的搜索半径内是否存在与类和/或标签筛选匹配的Actor。执行以上下文Actor的位置为中心的Sphere重叠测试，并使用指定的SearchRadius。重叠的Actor按ActorClass和/或TagQuery进行筛选。如果匹配Actor的数量落在RequiredCount范围内，则查询通过。上下文对象使用标准解析链解析为其最佳位置Actor：APawn > AActor > UActorComponent所有者（递归）。查询结果：- 当匹配的附近Actor的数量落在RequiredCount范围内时，返回**通过**- 当数量超出RequiredCount（太少或太多）时，返回**失败**- 当上下文对象无法解析为有效Actor时，返回**失败**- 当无法获取世界上下文时，返回**失败**筛选模式：- 仅限ActorClass：匹配指定类的Actor（默认情况下也匹配派生类）- ActorClass + bExactClassMatch：仅匹配精确类，不包括派生类- 仅限TagQuery：匹配标签通过查询的Actor- 两者（bRequireBothFilters）：Actor必须同时匹配类和标签筛选器- 两者（!bRequireBothFilters）：Actor必须匹配类或标签筛选器中的**任意一个**用例：- 区域感知：检查敌人是否在检测范围内- 接近触发器：验证附近至少有2个队友- 环境检查：检测可破坏对象是否在爆炸半径内- 人群检测：检查小区域内玩家是否过多@参见 FGameplayQuery_DistanceInRange，用于检查与特定Actor的距离@参见 GameplayQueryUtilities::ResolveLocationActor，用于Actor解析链

UObjectToolTips.GlobalVariableModifier_AddInt32Value:
FGlobalVariableModifier_AddInt32Value

将值添加到int32全局变量的修改器（相对修改）。行为：
- 如果变量存在：NewValue = CurrentValue + ValueToAdd（差量等于ValueToAdd）
- 如果变量不存在：创建值为0的变量，然后添加（NewValue = 0 + ValueToAdd）

值提供器：
使用FGameplayProviderNumerical支持固定值和动态值：
- 固定值：硬编码的增量/减量
- 动态值：根据其他变量、条件等计算添加量
- 负值：使用负数执行减法运算（例如，-10减少10）

差量追踪：
应用该修改器后的差量始终等于添加的值：
- 向变量添加+5：差量 = +5（无论起始值如何）
- 向变量添加-3：差量 = -3（减法显示为负差量）
- 这使得AddInt32Value非常适合追踪增量变化

用例：
- 递增计数器：击败敌人时向KillCount添加+1
- 递减资源：武器开火时向AmmoCount添加-10
- 奖励积分：完成目标时向Score添加+100
- 应用伤害：向HealthPoints添加-25（或使用负值表示伤害）
- 进度追踪：达到里程碑时向QuestProgress添加+1
- 动态调整：根据难度乘数添加计算值

示例场景：
- 击杀追踪：每次击杀时向EnemiesDefeated添加+1
- 连击系统：向Score添加+(ComboLevel * 10)
- 资源消耗：死亡时向RemainingLives添加-1
- 难度缩放：向SpawnCount添加+(WaveNumber * 5)
- 条件奖励：使用提供器向Points添加+(Bonus ? 50 : 10)

整数溢出：
- 适用标准C++整数溢出行为（回绕）
- INT_MAX + 1回绕到INT_MIN
- INT_MIN - 1回绕到INT_MAX
- 为防止溢出，请在Gameplay逻辑中验证值或使用限制提供器

UObjectToolTips.GlobalVariableModifier_AddNumericalValue:
FGlobalVariableModifier_AddNumericalValue

将浮点值添加到数值型全局变量的修改器（带精度的相对修改）。行为：
- 如果变量存在：NewValue = CurrentValue + ValueToAdd（delta等于ValueToAdd）
- 如果变量不存在：创建值为0.0的变量，然后添加（NewValue = 0.0 + ValueToAdd）

数字与Int32：
该修改器操作的是FGlobalVariableType_Numeric（双精度浮点）变量，
而FGlobalVariableModifier_AddInt32Value操作的是整数型变量。在以下情况下使用数值型变量：
- 小数值（0.5、3.14、0.001等）
- 累积微小变化的高精度
- 平滑插值数值（百分比、乘数、标准化值）
- 超过int32限制的大值范围

值提供器：
使用FGameplayProviderNumerical支持固定值和动态值：
- 固定值：硬编码的增量/减量（可以是小数）
- 动态值：根据其他变量、条件等计算添加量
- 负值：使用负数执行减法原酸（例如，-0.5减少0.5）

差量追踪：
应用该修改器后的差量等于添加的值：
- 将+1.5添加到变量：差量= +1.5
- 将-0.25添加到变量：差量 = -0.25
- 小数差量以全精度保留

用例：
- 累积百分比：将+0.05添加到CritChance（增加5%）
- 平滑乘数：将+0.1添加到SpeedMultiplier
- 资源消耗：Stamina每帧添加-0.01
- 精确计算：生命值百分比、伤害修改器、插值数值
- 分数累积：为部分目标添加小数分数
- 物理值：速度、加速度、力的大小

示例场景：
- 增益叠加：每个增益向DamageMultiplier添加+0.15
- 逐渐消耗：每隔一定时间向Hunger添加-0.1
- 连击缩放：向CritMultiplier添加+(0.5 * ComboCount)
- 百分比追踪：向QuestCompletionPercent添加+12.5
- 平滑过渡：每帧向FadeAlpha添加+0.05

浮点精度：
- 使用双精度（64位）以实现高精度
- 适用于从极小值（0.0001）到极大值（数百万）的数值范围
- 注意极大累积值的浮点舍入问题
- 对于没有小数的整数，优先使用Int32以获得更好的性能

UObjectToolTips.GlobalVariableModifier_Int32MathOperatio:
FGlobalVariableModifier_Int32MathOperation

对int32全局变量执行数学运算（乘法、除法、取模）的修改器。行为：
- 如果变量存在：使用当前值和操作数执行运算
-如果变量不存在：创建值为0的变量，然后执行运算

运算详情：
- **乘法**：NewValue = CurrentValue * Operand
 - 如果值较大，可能会溢出（标准C++整数回绕）
 - 示例：100 * 5 = 500

- **除法**：NewValue = CurrentValue * Operand（整数除法，向零截断）
 -7/2 = 3（而非3.5）
 --7/2 = -3（而非-3.5）
 - 除以零：保留当前值并记录警告（安全失败）
 -示例：100/4 = 25

- **取模‌**：NewValue = CurrentValue % Operand（相除后的余数）
 -10% 3 = 1 (10 = 3*3 + 1，余数为1)
 -7% 5 = 2
 - 对零取模：保留当前值并记录警告（安全失败）
 -示例：10% 3 = 1

数值提供器：
使用FGameplayProviderNumerical支持固定和动态操作数：
- 固定值：硬编码的乘数、除数或取模值
- 动态值：根据变量、条件等计算操作数。

差量追踪：
差量计算公式为：NewValue - OldValue
- 乘以 2：差量 = CurrentValue（翻倍，差量等于原值）
- 除以2：差量 =-CurrentValue/2（减半，差量为负的一半）

用例：
-**乘法**：按难度缩放伤害、应用连击乘数、双倍奖励
- **除法**：惩罚时生命值减半、平均分配积分、计算平均值
- **取模**：循环指数（0-9 周期）、交替模式、偶数/奇数检测

示例场景：
- 难度缩放：相乘EnemyHealth * DifficultyMultiplier
- 分配奖励：相除TotalPoints / PlayerCount
- 循环生成：取模SpawnIndex % SpawnPointCount（回绕0-N）
- 连击系统：相乘Score * ComboMultiplier
- 资源共享：相除SharedResource / TeamSize

安全功能：
- 除以零：记录警告并保留当前值（无崩溃）
- 对零取模：记录警告并保留当前值（无崩溃）
- 整数溢出：标准C++回绕行为（无异常）

UObjectToolTips.GlobalVariableModifier_LogicalOperation:
FGlobalVariableModifier_LogicalOperation

使用基于查询的操作数对布尔全局变量执行逻辑运算（AND、OR、XOR）的修改器。行为：
- 如果变量存在：使用当前值和查询结果执行逻辑运算
- 如果变量不存在：创建一个值为false的新布尔变量，然后执行运算

查询评估：
- 在修改时评估操作数查询，以获取动态布尔值
- 查询结果通过 = true，失败 = false
- 如果未设置查询（IsValid() == false），则默认为false并记录警告

运算详情：
- AND: NewValue = CurrentValue && QueryResult - 用于添加要求
- OR:  NewValue = CurrentValue || QueryResult - 用于提供替代方案
- XOR: NewValue = CurrentValue != QueryResult - 用于排他状态

用例：
- 条件门控：用AND要求多个条件同时满足（HasKey AND IsDoorUnlocked）
- 回退逻辑：用OR在任一条件满足时启用（IsAdmin OR IsOwner）
- 排他状态：用XOR仅在条件变化时切换
- 复合要求：串联多个逻辑运算以实现复杂的逻辑

示例场景：
- 解谜门控：CanOpenGate AND HasAllGems = true（只有两者都为true，门才会打开）
- 成就解锁：CompletedQuest OR FoundSecret = true（任一为true即解锁）
- 状态变化检测：PreviousState XOR CurrentState = true（检测任何状态变化）

UObjectToolTips.GlobalVariableType_Int32:
FGlobalVariableType_Int32

一种全局变量类型，用于存储支持自动追踪差量的32位有符号整数。此类型针对离散整数值进行了优化，并支持差量跟踪，以检测
数值更新之间的变化。每次调用SetValue()时自动计算差量，
使反应和系统能够根据变化的幅度和方向做出响应。用例：
-计数器：KillCount、DeathCount、ItemsCollected、EnemiesDefeated
- 分数值： CurrentScore、HighScore、PointsEarned
- 离散数量：AmmoCount、RemainingLives、HealthPoints（以整数计）
- 进度索引：CurrentLevel、WaveNumber、CheckpointIndex、RoundNumber
- 枚举状态：将int32用作状态机的底层类型

值范围：-2,147,483,648 到2,147,483,647（有符号32位整数）

差量追踪：自动计算新旧值之间的差异。- 值增加（10 -> 15）： 差量 = +5
- 值减少（10 -> 3）：差量 = -7
- 无变化（10 -> 10）：差量 = 0
- 初始设置（0 -> 5）：差量 = +5（从默认值0开始）

溢出/下溢行为：
整型溢出遵循标准C++回绕行为（有意为之，未经验证）：
- 加法：INT_MAX + 1回绕到INT_MIN
- 减法：INT_MIN - 1回绕到INT_MAX
- 乘法：大值可能溢出

UObjectToolTips.FortConditionalTransitionComponent:
Fort Conditional Transition Actor Component
This Game Framework Component can be added onto any actor to provide multiple types (including world and player instanced) tracking of different phases
Phases are defined by Targeted reactions that are granted when the phase is entered, and Conditionals that when met will
process going to a new phase for the instigator (Game state for world instanced, and individual player state for player instanced.)
For Player instanced handling, each player state has its own phases tracked on this component, allowing for different visual representations
and different conditionals to be processed on a per-player basis.

UObjectToolTips.FortTimedActorWaveSpawner:
FortTimedActorWaveSpawner is an actor that spawns a given actor class in waves, based on component locations and given wave tiers.

The general idea is to use this in a fire & forget scenario; simply spawn the actor and it will handle spawning other actors & cleanup itself.
Has settings for speed of wave spawning, actor lifetime, and potentially launch characters that are in the way of the spawning.
If WaitForSpawnEvent is enabled, it will be less fire and forget and require a call to finish spawning/cleanup.
It can also be given a particle system to spawn as indicators, before the actors are spawned.

Make sure to pass a pawn instigator when spawning this actor, if your actor spawn class's are BGA's!

UObjectToolTips.EMaterialPropertyType: 函数库类。其中的每个函数都应该是静态，并且表示可以在任何蓝图中调用的蓝图节点。在声明函数时，可以为节点定义元数据。关键帧函数指定符将是BlueprintPure和BlueprintCallable。BlueprintPure -意味着该函数不以任何方式影响所属对象，因此创建了一个没有Exec引脚的节点。BlueprintCallable——创建一个可以在蓝图中执行的函数——因此它有Exec引脚。DisplayName - 节点的完整名称，当你将鼠标移到节点上并在蓝图下拉菜单中显示。它允许你使用c++函数名中不允许使用的字符名称节点。CompactNodeTitle -出现在节点上的词语。关键字-关键字列表，当你使用蓝图下拉菜单搜索节点时，它可以帮助你找到节点。很好的例子是“Print String”节点，你也可以通过使用关键字“log”找到它。类别-你的节点将在蓝图下拉菜单中的类别。有关自定义蓝图节点的更多信息，请访问文档：https://wiki.unrealengine.com/Custom_Blueprint_Node_Creation// 类似于材质验证插件 - 暂时需要用于我们的自定义UStruct显示

              (e.g. in your NotifyAbilityFailed override, create FGasEvent_NotifyAbilityFailed at the start of the function, then call Commit() at the end.)

Gameplay conditional that fires when verb messages are received.
Bridges the VerbFramework and GameplayConditionalFramework.
Native counterpart of the Verse gameplay_conditional_verbs type.
The Verse counterpart's GetDeltaForVerbMessage override point has no C++ equivalent.
VerbFilter listeners use the delta provided by the filter; VerbMessageType listeners hardcode delta 1.0.

Supports two listening modes (configured on the definition):
  - VerbFilters: instanced verb filter structs that evaluate and provide a delta
  - VerbMessageTypes: verb message struct types that match by type (delta defaults to 1.0)

Config lives on FVerbGameplayConditionalDefinition. This struct holds only mutable
runtime state (registered handles). The base class OwningDefinition view (TConstStructView) provides
access to config during initialization.

UObjectToolTips.NPCChatterBaseComponent:
Generic chatter presentation: turns an event tag into a spoken line.

The NPC's own dialog is looked up in DialogSet from the identity tags it carries, so one component
class injected onto a whole pawn class still gives each NPC its own lines. Given that dialog and an
event tag, it selects a weighted line on the server and drives the presentation:
  - text  -> the sibling UFortPawnComponent_SpeechBubble (StartCustomSpeech), which replicates it;
  - audio -> a spatialized VO multicast played on clients;
  - chat  -> optionally the same text in the text chat feed, as an NPC message addressed to
             everyone or to the NPC's team (see GetChatNpcId / TextMessageAudience).
Selecting a single line and driving every output keeps the bubble text, the VO and the chat entry in sync.

This base is deliberately event-agnostic: it knows nothing about combat, perception, or which
gameplay events map to which tags. Derived classes (C++ or Blueprint) own event registration and
simply call DoChatter with the appropriate tag. A combat-flavoured subclass, for example, binds the
pawn / perception / controller delegates and routes them to Chatter.* tags.

Server-authoritative: selection happens on authority only; the component is replicated so the VO
multicast reaches clients. Anti-spam is per-event (Cooldown) plus a priority window so a more
important line can interrupt a less important one.

Extend by overriding OnChatterPlayed, and/or by adding FChatterVoiceLine subclasses to the dialog.

UObjectToolTips.AimConeDefinition:AttackRange:
瞄准锥的效果以全强度应用之前的距离（以厘米为单位）。必须小于或等于持续范围。在此范围内累积的强度由范围衰减曲线的前半部分控制。注意：此处输入的值实际上是最小持续范围
最小攻击距离 == 0
最大攻击距离 < 维持范围
UObjectToolTips.AimConeDefinition:DecayRange:
瞄准锥的效果完全消失前的距离（以厘米为单位）。必须大于或等于持续范围。最大持续范围（持续+攻击）和衰减范围之间的衰减由范围衰减曲线的后半部分控制。该范围在持续范围的基础上叠加，因此
最小衰减范围 > 持续范围 + 攻击范围
最大衰减范围 == 攻击范围 + 持续范围 + 衰减范围
UObjectToolTips.AimConeDefinition:SustainRange:
瞄准锥体效果以全强度应用的最大距离（厘米）。此范围将在攻击范围上累加，因此
最小持续范围 == 攻击范围
最大持续范围 == 攻击范围+持续范围

UObjectToolTips.FortRangedWeaponSpread:RecoveryTime:
How long it will take for spread to fully recover from reaching this shot number.
Recovery Time for Bullet Num 1 (if there's an entry for Bullet Num 1) should be 0.00, since that's the spread for when the first shot is ready, and there's no further recovery required.
After that, any entries with a 0.00 Recovery Time will not be used in Recoveyr Time calculation.
Recovery Time is linearly interpolated between entries with valid Recovery Time.
Note: Later entries need to have higher recovery times than those that came before...
      E.g., If I want 5 seconds between shot 1 and 2, I should set shot 2's recovery time to 5... But if I want to recover from shot 12 to shot 2 in 1 second, I should set its recovery time to 6 (5+1)
      The recovery time added per bullet after bullet 2 is lerped over the bullets it takes to get there, i.e., firing up to bullet 7 will require .5 seconds to get back to bullet 2 or 5.5 to fully recover.
      TLDR A: New entries need their recovery time set to the prior entries recovery time + this entries desired recovery time.
      TLDR B: The difference in the new entries recovery time from the last is then divided by this entries BulletNum minus the previous entries BulletNum, where only whem firing up this entries BulletNum will give you the full recovery.
If you actually mean to have an instant recovery from anything later than the first shot, just set Recovery Time to 0.01 -- it will recover in the first Tick.
UObjectToolTips.FortRangedWeaponRecoil:RecoveryTime:
How long it will take for the recoil counter to return to zero after firing this shot and ceasing further firing.
The first entry requires a Recovery Time greater than 0.00 to use per-bullet recoil recovery.
Any entry after that with a 0.00 Recovery Time will not be used in Recovery Time calculation.
Recovery Time is linearly interpolated between entries with valid Recovery Time.
If you actually mean to have an instant recovery from anything later than the first shot, just set Recovery Time to 0.01 -- it will recover in the first Tick.

UObjectToolTips.EAcquireIncrementType.UniqueItemCount:
If any item passes the filter, updates the objective by the number of unique items acquired in this event.
Example: When gaining 3 different matching items, with stack sizes of 5, 8, and 12, and 1 non-matching item with a stack size of 5
will progress the objective by 4 (total unique items gained in the event)
Example Quest: "Gain X different rewards from daily quests", filter looks for daily reward token, so all non-daily tokens do not pass the filter,
but should progress the quest by 1 for each item gained.
Note: for unique gains, is best paired with the tracked data component looking for the base tag
UObjectToolTips.EAcquireIncrementType.TotalItemCount:
If any item passes the filter, updates the objective by the total of all item stack sizes
Example: When gaining 3 different matching items, with stack sizes of 5, 8, and 12, and 1 non-matching item with a stack size of 5
will progress the objective by 30 (5+8+12+5, total of all items gained in the event)
Example Quest:  "Gain X rewards from daily quests", filter looks for daily reward token, so all non-daily tokens do not pass the filter,
but should progress the quest by stack size.

UObjectToolTips.VehicleModStaticMeshAttachmentData:Colli:
如果设置为true，则会在所有客户端本地焊接网格。
这会导致静态网格影响载具操控。

除非绝对必要，否则最好将此值设为false。只有外观的网格不需要启用此功能。

如果启用此功能，请不要在未将此属性与游戏数据中的一行挂钩的情况下保留此属性。
我们需要能够在紧急情况下关闭此功能。
自我碰撞很容易成为复杂的圆形焊接和复制的问题。

注：如果设置为 true，静态网格组件将不会被复制，也不能通过复制变量或 RPC 调用。
物理焊接不会作为场景组件附件的一部分被复制。
在本地生成网格是为了避免服务器上已设置碰撞但客户端未焊接的静态网格产生内部碰撞问题。

注意：焊接不能很好地与插槽配合使用。
此功能会将其放置在你指定的插槽/骨骼上。
但实际上它将被焊接到根部，而不是插槽上。
这意味着动画骨骼上的任何插槽都不会移动网格。
如果需要动画，请使用非焊接网格。

UObjectToolTips.CosmeticPortComponent:
In-development by Cosmetic Tech - do not use, please! Contact us first for any questions or queries.

Part of Cosmetic Tech's Dev Acceleration Initiative.
To replace the hard-coded existing EFortCustomPartType::NumTypes with a new tag based system

Will rely on tags to determine what space a Port will occupy. You will then be able to query these spaces to get
the Ports that you are looking for. So instead of asking for a Part Type Enum like before for the head, you can request
'Cosmetic.Ports.Head' (naming with tags TBD).

This class will be the source of truth for our Desired and our Applied Parts. Desired is what we would like to be on the
Cosmetic Object (Pawn/Character/etc) and will be Soft References as they are unloaded. Applied is what our Desired
eventually becomes after being loaded by Flowgraph/Applicator and will be Hard References as they are loaded.

TDD: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1V--UBiyNHthI0pKB65j3UVqq3zDHsBEj93aNld4fYaA/edit?usp=sharing

UObjectToolTips.FortMcpQuestObjectiveInfo:BackendName:
Internal name used by MCP, DO NOT CHANGE THIS ON EXISTING QUESTS or players will lose quest progress.

BackendNames must be globally unique because the MCP backend service uses the backendname for an objective
to track progression. If a quest which already shipped and was on player profiles, and the objective BackendNames
changed, that would result in players losing all progress on that objective, which is a very devastating outcome.
Because of that, renaming a quest asset doesn't touch backendnames because we don't have a way to check if that
quest has already shipped, so we can block the rename. This is definitely an annoyance, however it's the best of the
bad options, as the alternative is giving content developers a way to inadvertently cause data loss on quest progression for players

UObjectToolTips.AIPawnSignificanceBasedMovementUpdateBuc:
Keeps track of a group of movement components and how many frames have passed since they were updated
last. A single bucket will have a number of groups equal to its FramesPerUpdate value. Only one group
per bucket is updated on a single frame, with the updated group changing each frame to achieve a
staggered AI pawn character movement update pattern.
UObjectToolTips.FabricSignificanceBasedUpdateBucket: 记录所有因与该桶相关的重要性而被追踪的织物对象。将桶划分为更新组以进行Tick。
UObjectToolTips.AIPawnSignificanceBasedMovementUpdateBuc:
Keeps track of all movement components whose pawn's significance falls within a certain range. All
components in a bucket will update with the same frequency (i.e. one update per FramesPerUpdate
frames) but they will be split into groups that are staggered onto different frames (i.e. a bucket
with FramesPerUpdate = 3 will have 3 groups with all components in the bucket spread equally
throughout them, and only one group will update per frame).

UObjectToolTips.AudioClusterAlgorithm_Cone:
Legacy algorithm to cluster related actors together in sectors centered around the listener position.
Note: This algorithm ignores FAudioClusterConfiguration::AlgorithmUpdateRateMs and does its costly updates every frame.

A sector is a portion of a 2D ring (previously misnamed as "cone").
The ring starts after SectorMinRadius meters, and ends before SectorMaxRadius meters. It is then restricted to SectorWidth degrees. This gives you
a sector. Exception for actors in the SectorMinRadius: each will get its own cluster where it will sit on its own, even if two actors are in the
same "visual" sector. In other words, anything closer than SectorMinRadius is clustered on its own (with cluster size 1 and its own emitter).

When an actor is in range but fits no existing clusters, a new cluster is created for that actor alone, and that cluster's position is initialized
to that of the actor.

When actors or the listener move:
1. For each actor, from oldest to youngest cluster, if actor location is in cluster, move it there if not already in it.
2. For each cluster, update its position to be the point at closest actor's distance, in the direction of last cluster position.

UObjectToolTips.FortLightPawnProxy:
LightPawn proxy for "No Pawn" island mode. Serves as the player controller's anchor in island
modes where no gameplay pawn (BR, vehicle, etc.) is initially needed.

Inherits ADefaultPawn to guarantee zero Battle Royale subsystem coupling
(VKPlay safe). Invisible and immobile acts purely as a session
placeholder until the controller transitions to a vehicle or other
gameplay pawn.

Volume registration is handled in PossessedBy via AddUserToVolume because
the standard overlap path in CreativeBlueprintLibrary gates on
Cast<AFortPlayerPawn>. Volumes register by PlayerState (not Pawn), and the
controller handles deregistration on disconnect via ForceRemoveFromVolumes,
so UnPossessed does no volume/playspace cleanup membership is sticky.

Sleep/wake (net dormancy): when the controller leaves the proxy for another
pawn (e.g. a vehicle) the proxy is NOT destroyed it stays alive as the
controller's anchor but is put to sleep in UnPossessed (DORM_DormantAll +
ticks off).

UObjectToolTips.FortAnimNode_RootSlopeTilt: 轻量级骨骼控制，仅使骨架根骨向地板法线倾斜夹紧的、平滑的斜率角的一部分。根下的所有内容都继承旋转。旨在直接位于完整斜率扭曲节点的上游（例如FFortAnimNode_QuadrupedSlopeWarping（在其每肢体模式下）：它会将身体向斜坡倾斜，使得下游的每肢体解算将脚重新放置在已经倾斜的身体上，而不是让腿去承受整个斜坡的变形（这样会导致腿变形，尤其在平行于坡度线行走时最为严重——相关记录：FORT-1090303 / FORT-1066015）。该功能从所属Actor的 UCharacterMovementComponent 或 UFortSlopeWarpingComponent 中读取地面信息，因此它不执行自身的任何射线检测；同时它通过 OutBoneTransforms 输出单个骨骼变换，从而使结果能够与节点的 Alpha 正确混合。

row (which has no slot to resolve), and for a rare row where no live occupant matched.

UObjectToolTips.EBoolLogicalOperation.AND:
逻辑AND - 仅当变量和操作数都为true时，结果才为true
真值表：true AND true = true | 所有其他组合 = false
用例：门激活（需要多个条件）、权限检查
UObjectToolTips.EBoolLogicalOperation.OR:
逻辑OR - 如果变量或操作数中的任何一个为true（或两者都为true），则结果为true
真值表：false OR false = false | 所有其他组合 = true
用例：替代条件、回退状态、可选要求
UObjectToolTips.EBoolLogicalOperation.XOR:
逻辑XOR（异或） - 如果变量和操作数不同，则结果为true
真值表：（true XOR false）= true | （false XOR true）= true | 匹配值 = false
用例：切换检测、状态比较、排他性开关

UObjectToolTips.FortVehicleModComponent:SeatInputCompone:
Maps a seat(index) to input component data for that seat.
The EVehicleSeats enum is designer friendly, but corresponds to player seats indices in the vehicle seats array.

These input components, when pushed, allow enhanced input to function for blueprint subclass of the mod component.
While code can manually bind to an input event, Blueprint just creates an event for the input action associated with an input context mapping.
However, those events only broadcast normally under controller components, or something owned by a controller.
Vehicle pawns do not appear to be directly possessed by the player, input is not routed here. (Even if it were, more boiler plate may be necessary, like calling AActor::EnableInput)
So, we create input components for each seat. When a player takes control of a seat, it can have an input component pushed to the controller's input component stack.

The input component
     1) enables input forwarding to blueprint.
     2) Can mask/suppress legacy input actions/axes.

NOTE: When clearing this data, be sure to remove it from the player controller's input component stack, to avoid input being stuck on.

UObjectToolTips.LACombatSmootherConfig:EnableCrouchStick: 下蹲粘性主开关：一旦策略触发下蹲，强制其保持下蹲状态至少CrouchStickinessSeconds秒。防止单帧下蹲切换。

UObjectToolTips.LACombatSmootherConfig:EnableSlideSticki: 滑动粘性主开关：一旦策略触发从蹲伏滑动的门（UAIActionSlide），则强制其保持触发状态至少SlideStickinessSeconds。与EnableCrouchStickiness并行，但独立于蹲伏锁定应用于滑动门。
UObjectToolTips.LACombatSmootherConfig:EnableSprintStick: 冲刺粘性的主切换：一旦策略触发战术冲刺，则强制其保持激活至少SprintStickinessSeconds。平滑单帧冲刺闪烁。
UObjectToolTips.LACombatGuards:EnableNoSprintCloseRange: 近距离禁止冲刺守卫的主开关。启用时，在机器人连续NoSprintCloseRangeHoldSeconds秒处于其目标NoSprintCloseRangeCm范围内之后，策略的战术冲刺输出将被强制关闭。在面对面范围内停止冲刺轨道同时仍允许冲刺飞过近距离范围。

UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaMutator_BackFillControl:
Mutator designed to give customizable control over backfill logic.
Note that this mutator does not consider bMutatorActive.
Instead, the existence of the actor indicates the intent to control backfill.
If it should no longer control backfill, the actor can be destroyed on the fly,
or destroyed immediately by hotfixing bDestroyInBeginPlay.
Proper playlist settings:
1. bAllowBackfill: true
2. bAllowJoinInProgress: true
    In past events, this was found to be necessary for backfill to function at all.
3. MinBackfillMatchPlayers: 1 through MaxPlayers
    Minimum number of players we want a backill request to grab for us,
    NOT the minimum total player count we want backfill to help us achieve.
    In GetServerBackfillOptionsV2() this is dynamically clamped/reduced to
    the number of players we're lacking to reach MaxPlayers (or UnderfilledMaxPlayers).
    So if MinBackfillMatchPlayers is 4, but you currently only need 3 players to reach
    MaxPlayers/UnderfilledMaxPlayers, then the backfill options' MinPlayerCount is clamped to 3.
4. bUnderfillMatchmaking: true or false
    If true, UnderfilledMaxPlayers is utilized in determing the total player count we want backfill to help us reach.
    If false, MaxPlayers is used.
5. UnderfilledMaxPlayers: < MaxPlayers
    If bUnderfillMatchmaking is true, this is the player count we would like
    the backfill system to help us reach, rather than MaxPlayers.
6. bEnableBackfillDuringWarmupPhase: false
    Using false will avoid UFortGameStateComponent_BattleRoyaleGamePhaseLogic starting
    or stopping backfill and fighting with us.
    Even if it's true, though, we just stomp backfill to what we want in our periodic UpdateBackfill().
7. TimeAfterWarmupToDisableBackfill: any value (just use default)
    Only used if bEnableBackfillDuringWarmupPhase = true.
    If our FinalPhase > Warmup, there may be a period of time when
    the low level logic disables backfill due to bEnableBackfillDuringWarmupPhase/TimeAfterWarmupToDisableBackfill,
    but then we might toggle it back in the next periodic call to UpdateBackfill().

UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaMutator_Knockback:
Mutator that causes weapons to do knockback to players instead of damage.

To make use of this system, add this mutator and the Mutator_Knockback_ReroutePlayerEvent BP to your playlist.
(The reroute mutator handles combining damage that is applied in multiple events (eg shotgun shots) into one damage event for knockback use.)
Apply the following GAs to all players. You may want to create child GAs in order to set the scalable float values to table rows.
GA_HandlePlayerKnocback, GA_KnockbackVehicles, GA_ReimburseHealthOnKnockback, GA_StructureDestruction)
You may also want to create/apply a GE that modifies weapon's damage (eg PhosphorusWipeout/Shockwave scaled shotgun damage by 1.25).

UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaMutator_LightPawn:
Mutator that overrides the default pawn class with a LightPawn alternative.

Pawn override: Replaces AFortPlayerPawnAthena in GetDefaultPawnClassForController
with AFortLightPawnProxy — a pawn with zero BR subsystem dependencies that is
playable and crash-free in island contexts. Prevents save/load failures and
runtime errors from BR widgets expecting state that does not exist on non-BR pawns.

Activation: The LightPawn GFP loads via VKPlayminimumRoot dependency (Temporal while UE-369490 done)
the mutator present in all UEFN islands. Inside GetDefaultPawnClassForController,
the mutator only overrides when the Fort.bForceLightPawn CVAR is set (debug path).
The IslandSettings Pawn Selection dropdown is the production path and is handled by
AFortGameModeAthena::GetDefaultPawnClassForController_Implementation directly.

Registers in both GameMode and GameState MutatorListComponents: GameMode
for server-side pipelines (pawn class selection, spawning, game flow) and
GameState for client-side pipelines (HUD visibility, world resource widgets).

Currently ships with AFortLightPawnProxy (No Pawn mode) as the first supported
selection. Future: integrates with the pawn selection dropdown (UE-369545) to
support additional pawn types without island settings or GFS-level validation or VKPlayMinimunRoot Depedency.

UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaMutator_RespawnAndSpectateSele:
显示用户界面菜单的变化器，阵亡玩家可以在其中选择旁观重生目标，以及在哪个重生目标附近重生。该变化器将保存一份重生目标列表，其中的Actor是玩家可以重生的位置。通常情况下，玩家可以在其队伍有权访问的任意已启用重生目标处重生，每个重生目标处可重生的玩家数量不限。重生目标可以随时添加/移除。重生目标必须在服务器上添加，添加方法有两种：
 （1）通过启用bAllowRespawnOnLivingTeammates和bAllowRespawnOnLivingSquadmates等标记，自动生成特定的重生目标；
 （2）使用AddRespawnTargetData()手动添加重生位置
一旦添加，重生目标将持续存在到游戏结束，或者通过调用RemoveRespawnTargetData()从服务器中手动移除

要使用该变化器，必须将一个派生自RespawnAndSpectateContainerWidget的控件加入播放列表。该控件将充当此变化器的UI。你可以通过让类实现IRespawnAndSpectateSelectManager，然后使用SetManager()将其设置为管理该类，从而实现特殊的重生位置/变换规则

在实现该类时，你可能希望始终使用AddRespawnTargetData()为每个队伍添加至少1个默认重生目标。该重生目标可在所有队伍之间共享，也可专属于某一支队伍。可以有多个默认重生目标，但不建议这样做（无随机化功能，其中一个将成为有效的默认值，而其余的可能永远不会被当做默认值使用）。默认重生目标应为一个重复且始终相关的Actor，其位置应确保相应队伍的玩家始终能在该位置重生。通过AddRespawnTargetData(InputData)设置默认重生目标，其中InputData.bShouldBeSelectedByDefault== true。默认重生目标的用途：
（1）如果玩家没有旁观目标，或者玩家的旁观目标已失效（这种情况常发生于玩家断开连接或阵亡时），则用于设置玩家的旁观目标。（2）当玩家因为在重生界面等待过久而被强制重生时，如果他们没有有效的旁观目标，则将在默认重生目标处重生。注意：控制台命令作弊“RespawnScreenToggleMakeAllRespawnTargetsAvailableToAllPlayers”在测试中十分实用。它能让屏幕在只有1名玩家的情况下正常工作，而通常情况下，1个小队或1支队伍中必须有多名玩家。

UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaMutator_DestroyActorsAndCompon:
Mutator used for specifying actors and components to destroy, and when.
This can be useful for blocking functionality or improving performance, by removing
actors/components that are not utilized or are deemed non-critical for an LTM or special event.
Actors are processed for destruction at these points in time:
 1. [All preexisting actors] AFortAthenaMutator_DestroyActorsAndComponents::BeginPlay().
 2. [Placed actors only] FWorldDelegates::LevelAddedToWorld, which we bind our OnLevelAddedToWorld() to.
 3. [Spawned actors only] UWorld::OnActorSpawned, which we bind our OnActorSpawned() to.
 4. [Server] Upon enabling/reenabling a corresponding ActorDefinition with SetActorDefinitionsEnabled().
 5. [Client] OnRep_ActorDefinitions(), after enabling/reenabling an ActorDefinition on the server.
Components created dynamically after any of the above cases are not currently monitored for,
as there is not an on-component-created delegate to bind to, and periodic checks could be costly.

UObjectToolTips.NotificationRequest:
Notification request passed to the handler. Carries everything a presenter needs
to display one notification: visible data (title, message, icon, background,
action buttons), timing (duration), an optional per-request widget class override,
and the callbacks the handler fires when the user interacts or the timer expires.

Typical construction happens inside UEvoCoreNotificationSubsystem's ShowToast and
ShowDialog methods (severity preset stamped onto Icon/Color, then dispatched
to the handler). For custom Actions or callbacks, callers in EvoCore can build a
request directly and dispatch via the concrete subsystem's handler getters.
