UObjectToolTips.PropertyDisplayData:ContainerObjectName:
Occasionally, it is necessary to display properties that are nested within other structs or classes,
rather than just the properties at the root level of the object. These nested properties can have
identical names, leading to potential ambiguities. By specifying the name of the class or struct
explicitly, we can accurately identify and display the intended property, even if multiple properties
share the same name across different scopes. This approach ensures precise and unambiguous property
retrieval and display in the Unreal Engine's property system.

UObjectToolTips.DynamicUIAdjustInfo:
One entry of a scene's Adjust list, returned by AddAdjust and ListAdjust.

An Adjust entry overrides the layout constraint and/or size modifier of a widget that is already
allowed on screen -- possibly by a different active scene (see the runtime combining in
SDynamicUIPanel). It is keyed by its target widget; configure its constraint/size with the
SetConstraint* and SetSize* tools passing Target=Adjust.

One entry of a scene's Allowed (Allow) list, returned by ListAllowedWidgets.

An Allowed entry declares a widget that this scene permits on screen, plus how it is drawn

whether layout/size/exclude modifiers are attached. Mutators target entries by (WidgetClass, UniqueID).

One entry of a scene's Unallow list, returned by ListUnallow and the AddUnallow* tools.

An Unallow rule hides/collapses/destroys widgets while this scene is active. Three strategies exist; only the
fields for this entry's Type are populated, the rest are left empty/default.

UObjectToolTips.RegionalAIDisclosureMessage: 一个区域披露消息，定义一次，并由任意数量的规则通过MessageId引用。正文来自以下两个来源之一：  - 烘焙：StringTableKey命名组件的AI披露字符串表资产中的条目，并将其收集    到.locres中。通过正常的本地化管线。不可热修复（已烘焙内容），但已知区域的唯一    真实来源。- 热修复：文本携带其自身的命名空间+键+原生字符串+每文化内联翻译，因此    新区域可以在其副本烘焙之前上线。在加载/热修复时向本地化管理器    注册。当两者都存在时，内联文本优先，因此实时热修复可以重载烘焙条目，而无需内容补丁。这两条路径提供相同的可见副本，但却是不同的FText标识（内联=可本地化的命名空间+键，携带原生源字符串；烘焙=字符串表id+键）。热修复 -> 烘焙提升仅当内联命名空间与字符串表收集的命名空间匹配（由资产固定，此处不可设置）并且内联NativeString与收集的源保持字节相同，才与显示字符串相同；否则客户端将回退到原生字符串，直到内联文本被移除。StringTableKey的正确性仅通过内容审核来强制执行——配置（无表引用）和DS（本地化解析关闭）都无法验证它。

One tile of the transition grid. Holds transitions whose Position.XY falls inside

lists for its own polys.
UObjectToolTips.MultiNavigationNavmeshTransition:
One vertical-column link between two sub-navmeshes inside a multi-navmesh composite.
Persistent fields: Position (column XY), FromZ/ToZ (surface heights), FromIdx/ToIdx
(indexes into SubNavmeshes — populated by ResolveSubNavmeshes, sorted by actor FName).
If the resolved set changes (sub added/removed/renamed), ResolveSubNavmeshes wipes
the TileMap so stale indices can't point at the wrong sub.

FromPolyRef / ToPolyRef are cached resolved poly refs from the last RebuildTileEdges
pass. They're persisted so RebuildTileEdges can validate-and-reuse via
Sub->IsNodeRefValid instead of always re-projecting; if the validity check fails
(sub rebuilt since save), it falls back to ProjectPoint and overwrites them.

UObjectToolTips.FortPawnComponent_CosmeticLoadoutPredict:
Optional pawn component that owns client-side cosmetic loadout prediction: applying a locally-resolved cosmetic
loadout to the owning pawn ahead of the server's authoritative update, waiting out any on-demand cosmetic downloads
that loadout needs, and reconciling against the authoritative loadout once it replicates down.

Prediction is only possible while this component is present on the pawn, so contexts where predicting is acceptable
can add it and everything else remains untouched. It is recommended that external code uses the helper functions
in FortCosmeticLoadoutUtils rather than fetching this component themself each time, unless a special use case or
finer control is needed.

As of creation, only relevant to Hestia Beauty contexts in Save The World. Check carefully before assuming it
will work in other contexts.

UObjectToolTips.DestroyActorsAndComponentsMutator_ActorD:
Passed to the bNetForce parameter of AActor::Destroy().  If true, destroy the actor regardless of Role or bNetTemporary.
Normally defaults to false in the Destroy() function.
We default to true, so that networked, non-NetTemporary actors are permitted to be destroyed on client.
For example, if it were false, and bDestroyActorOnServer/Client were both true, we might succeed at destroying a placed actor
on the server.  However, the destruction might not replicate, and our attempt to Destroy() on the client might fail.
We will log an error for any failure to destroy.
See how bNetForce is used in UWorld::DestroyActor().
Specifically, if bNetForce = false, and bNetTemporary = false, the client will fail to destroy.

UObjectToolTips.SparksVocalStreamControllerComponent:
Per-PlayerController component that owns the full vocal-streaming codec pipeline:
  send path:    raw mic PCM → FVocalStreamEncoder → timestamped FVocalAudioChunk → subsystem transport
  receive path: subsystem transport → OpusDecoder (per sender) → sync buffer → subsystem PushDecodedPCM

Collaborators:
  - USparksAudioCaptureComponent (found on the owning PC): raw audio source, and host of the
    sender-side MusicClock used to stamp chunks.
  - USparksVocalStreamSubsystem: owns channels + relay + decoded-PCM routing to audio buses.
    Subsystem dispatches incoming encoded chunks to the local-listener StreamController via
    OnEncodedAudioReceived.
  - USparksVocalStreamChannel: subsystem owns the channel map; StreamController never touches
    channels directly — just the RPC entry point for server-side channel opening.

Requires: added to APlayerController via GameFeatureAction_AddComponents in SparksMicrophone's
GameFeatureData. Dynamic AddComponentByClass at runtime breaks net RPCs (NetGUID mismatch).

UObjectToolTips.XpDetails_BoosterEntry:BoostedBonusXp: 每个加速器的奖励XP贡献。在单次发放时，每个条目取 FMath::FloorToInt32(BaseXpValue * XpBonusMultiplier * ProportionFactor)，其中 ProportionFactor = EffectiveMultiplier / UnclampedTotalMultiplier（无限制触发时为 1.0，全局总量上限触发时小于 1.0）；第一个条目吸收汇总后的 BoostedBonusXp 与各条目向下取整值之和之间的余数，从而使发放输出精确等于汇总值。每个条目的BoostedBonusXp永不为负。FXpDetails::Combine 随后会在 ItemId 匹配时，将另一个对象的 BoostedBonusXp 累加到保留的第一个条目中，从而在多次发放合并时保持审计追踪不变性：sum(BoostedBonusXpDetails[].BoostedBonusXp) == BoostedBonusXp，以便分析系统能够将每个加速器经验点归因到特定的加速器 ItemId。

UObjectToolTips.MultiNavigationSubMeshScaleOverride:Cost:
Per-sub-mesh traversal-cost multiplier. Applied to every node visited on the
matching sub-navmesh during A* (see ResolveSubMeshCostScale + GetTraversalCost
in MultiNavigationNavmeshQuery.cpp). 1.0 = no change; >1 makes the sub-mesh
less attractive; <1 makes it more attractive.

Prefer values >= 1. Setting CostScale < 1 scales the *actual* edge cost below
the heuristic's straight-line estimate, which breaks A*'s admissibility
guarantee — the search can then over-estimate the cost-to-goal and return
a sub-optimal path (or do extra work re-opening nodes). The clamp allows 0+
only so the property can be authored freely; if you set it <1, expect
pathfinding quality and perf to degrade on this sub-mesh.

UObjectToolTips.FortGameStateComponent_HackSystem:Consol: PerConsole mode fallback (see ConsoleActivationCountWeights): minimum number of override consoles that activate over a match. The total is rolled once per match from [MinCount, MaxCount].

PerConsole mode fallback: biases the per-match count roll across [MinCount, MaxCount]. Weight of each value = (DistanceFromNearestExtreme + 1) ^ Exponent. 0 = uniform, positive = center bias, negative = extreme bias.
PerConsole mode fallback: maximum number of override consoles that activate over a match. Set MinCount == MaxCount for a fixed, non-random count.
UObjectToolTips.FortGameStateComponent_HackSystem:CarryO: PerConsole mode, read as bool (0 = false): if true, activations a phase cannot fill carry to the next phase in the window so the rolled match total is still met; if false, the shortfall is dropped.
UObjectToolTips.FortGameStateComponent_HackSystem:Random: PerConsole mode, read as bool (0 = false): if true, the rolled activations spread across random distinct phases within the window; if false, they activate sequentially from MinPhase.
UObjectToolTips.FortGameStateComponent_HackSystem:Consol: PerConsole mode: earliest safe-zone phase index in which a rolled console activation can be scheduled.

PerConsole mode: how many override consoles activate over a match. Each key in the curve row is a count and its value that
count's relative weight, e.g. 1 = 65, 2 = 25, 3 = 10; key 0 explicitly to allow a match with none. Only keyed counts roll, so
this row replaces MinCount / MaxCount / CountBiasExponent - leave it unset to fall back to those.
PerConsole mode: latest safe-zone phase index in which a rolled console activation can be scheduled.

Persistent actor placed in a frontend map.
Listens to the selected island in UFortIslandManager and activates the link entry's frontend GameFeaturePlugin via refcount-managed state handles.
Frontend plugin lifetime is scoped to this actor's lifetime, which in turn is scoped to the frontend map's lifetime (handles released on EndPlay -> map unload).

Drop a single instance of this actor into a frontend .umap to opt that map into IslandManager-resolved frontend plugin activation.

Plugin name precedence: link entry > parent set. There is no default fallback. Maps that want a frontend plugin must declare it in their link metadata.

UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaPickRandomMontageStateTreeTask:
Picks a random Montage from a list.
Each Config has a weight that is used to decide how likely is for a montage to be picked.
Ex. if you have:
- montage A, weight 1
- montage B, weight 2
Montage A will have 33.33% to get picked (1/(1+2)) and Montage B will have a 66.66% to get picked (2/(1+2)).

Note: as most of the tasks, this will keep running forever until a transition happens.
UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaPickAnimByWorldConditionsState:
Picks an Anim (e.g. Montage or CAS) from a list based on the WorldConditions required to select each one.
 This runs through the list and returns the first Montage whose conditions are satisfied, so the order of the entries
 will matter if you intend to use parent tags, for example: add entry(s) with child tags BEFORE
 any entry that checks parent tags, so you can get more specific montages for specific children.

Note: as most of the tasks, this will keep running forever until a transition happens.

UObjectToolTips.InvulnLlamaHitFXComponent:
Plays a local hit-FX GameplayCue whenever the owning FortPawn is hit while invulnerable.

Bound to AFortPawn::OnGameplayCueDamaged, which is broadcast (on every relevant client, before
the zero-damage gate) for every incoming damage cue -- so it fires even when all damage is
prevented by FortHealthSet.DamageReduction. The cue is invoked LOCALLY: the damage cue itself is
already multicast by the server to all relevant clients, so each client runs OnGameplayCueDamaged
and plays its own burst. Executing locally avoids a second replication hop (and a double-play).

Add to FortPlayerPawn via the GameFeature's GameFeatureAction_AddComponents (client + server).
Gate with RequiredStateTag so the burst only plays while the invulnerability effect is active.

UObjectToolTips.ISGTestStructBase:
Polymorphic base for the struct-flavor fixtures. Hidden so it is never offered as a live type.

NOTE: Hidden is deliberately NOT applied to the concrete fixtures. UE::ISG::Private::IsTypeUnselectable treats
Hidden as "never offer this", so hiding them removes them from wrap candidates and the Ops wrap tests can no
longer find the wrappers they assert on. The same holds for the object fixtures: they must stay EditInlineNew and
unhidden because IsTypeUnselectable also rejects any class lacking CLASS_EditInlineNew, and UISGTestNestedObject is
asserted as an object-flavor wrap candidate (Ops.ObjectFlavorWrapPreservesTheOriginalValue).

Metadata cannot keep these types out of a shipping editor, and neither could a test-only module: this module
exports no API, so a sibling module could not link the internals the tests exercise. The extra entries an
unconstrained class picker offers are an accepted cost of an editor-only plugin.

UObjectToolTips.SpatialMetricsProfileSelectionRule: 配置文件选择规则定义基于源元数据自动选择配置文件的规则。使用虚幻的标准文本过滤器表达式语法（与内容浏览器过滤器相同）。表达式语法：- 比较：Key=Value、Key!=Value、Key<Value、 Key>Value、Key<=Value、Key>=Value- 文本匹配模式（控制值的匹配方式）：  - 默认：部分匹配（子字符串），例如"PlatformGroup=Console"匹配"Console"或"XboxOneConsole"  - +Value：精确匹配，例如"PlatformGroup=+Console"仅匹配"Console"  - Value...：以……开头，例如"PlatformGroup=PS..."匹配"PS4"或"PS5"  - ...Value：作为结尾，例如"PlatformGroup=...Console"匹配"XboxOneConsole"- 逻辑运算符：AND、OR、NOT、&&、||、！- 分组：使用括号（）- 引号：对于包含空格的值，使用单引号或双引号- 数字比较：当两边都是数字时自动检测示例：- "PlatformGroup=Console" - 部分匹配（包含"Console"）- "PlatformGroup=+PS5 OR PlatformGroup=+XSX" - PS5或XSX的精确匹配- "PlatformGroup=Console AND BuildConfig!=Shipping" - 多个条件- "(PlatformGroup=Mobile OR PlatformGroup=Desktop) AND InstanceType=PIE" - 分组逻辑- "FrameRate>30 AND FrameRate<=60" - 数字比较

UObjectToolTips.GameplayConditionalGateAction_RetriggerS:
Re-Trigger State Change Action
This action allows multiple calls to open or close a gate to process the opening or closing logic.
This works with delayed state change, and auto toggle timers, to restart the time before the action happens.
ie. A conditional to do X condition Y seconds after jumping would have a verb gate for jumping. This gate would have an auto toggle action set for Y seconds.
It would also have the re-trigger action on it, so if you had jumped less than Y seconds ago, a new jump would restart the timer at Y seconds before the state toggles.

UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderAimMathDrivenConfig:RemapMin: 在与AimMath权重相乘之前应用于姿势驱动器输出的重映射范围。让绑定师将狭窄的驱动器输出带拉伸为完整瞄准：例如RemapMin=0.0,RemapMax=0.25使瞄准在姿势的原始激活达到25%时达到最大强度。默认为(0, 1) = 直通恒等。低于RemapMin的值限制为0，高于RemapMax的值限制为1。两端都包含在内。
UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderParentConstraintConfig:RemapM: 在用于混合姿势之前，重映射范围应用于姿势的驱动器输出累加器朝向约束结果。镜像瞄准重映射行为：值被拉伸，因此[RemapMin, RemapMax]映射到[0, 1]。让绑定师在狭窄的驱动器激活带上达到完全约束强度——例如RemapMin=0.0,当姿势的原始激活达到25%时，RemapMax=0.25会完全触发约束。默认值（0, 1）=直通标识。
UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderCurveMathOp:D: 重映射目标最大值（仅当Op == Remap时使用）。
UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderCurveMathOp:C: 重新映射目标最小值（仅当Op == Remap时使用）。
UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderAxisProjectionOperation:Remap: 以厘米为单位重映射阈值。有符号投影（反转后）通过[RemapMin, RemapMax] -> [0, 1]进行映射：低于RemapMin = 0，高于RemapMax = 1，中间线性。允许负值（例如RemapMin = -2，RemapMax = 5在骨骼水平之前2cm处开始斜坡）。默认值（0，5）表示“当骨骼沿轴线水平时激活率为0%，当驱动器在测试方向上超过目标5cm或更远时激活率为100%” 。

UObjectToolTips.FortWaterDepthOccluderComponent:
在水体表面下方渲染一个遮挡体平面，以免水下地形产生高成本的
地形着色开销。该平面在基础渲染通道中渲染，使用最小的无光照不透明材质。因为不透明，所以它会自然地写入深度缓冲区。遮挡体下方的
地形像素无法通过深度测试，并完全跳过其像素着色器。水面在上方渲染，完全覆盖遮挡体的颜色输出，
使其在最终图像中不可见。适用于所有平台，包括移动平台（不依赖深度预通道）。将此组件添加到水体Actor。

UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaMutator_SE_Respawn_AllowedPlay:
Replicated FastArray containing the players this mutator currently wants allow to respawn for.
Setting a breakpoint in AFortGameStateAthena::IsRespawningAllowed() in PIE
showed that it was called on client for both local and non-local players.
Replication could conceivably lead to timing edge cases where the client calls IsRespawningAllowed()
just prior to a change in the replicated data.  But with the server being authority over
respawning, it would hopefully only result, at worst, in a cosmetic miscommunication to the player,
such as temporarily incorrect information in the HUD.

UObjectToolTips.FortAthenaLoadoutReplicator:
Replicates a FFortAthenaLoadout by first serializing it and converting any hard refs to FPrimaryAssetIds.
Once replicated to the client, this will async load any of the primary assets.
When the asyn load completes, a delegate the owning actor must bind to is called. This delegate
has a FCosmeticLoadoutUpdater which the owner can use to apply the updates to their FFortAthenaLoadout.

This is meant to be replicated in place of a FFortAthenaLoadout to prevent any hard references
from being loaded by the replication system if they're not already preloaded.

UObjectToolTips.CosmeticLoadoutSlot:
Represents a single area of cosmetic customization in a player's loadout (e.g. a character or backpack). This is the
in-game equivalent of a CosmeticBackendLoadoutSlot.

Items are represented by primary asset IDs and hard references.
Only their FPrimaryAssetId will be replicated.
Hard references will be async loaded and resolved via FCosmeticLoadout::PostReplicateAsyncResolveDefinitions.

Supports robust checking against slot requirements when slotting new items, customization data validation, etc.

This is a struct so it can be Blueprint accessible and support reflection without being a full-fat UObject, but
most data access is protected

Provides a place to track dynamically spawned vehicle mod data for a given vehicle.
In some cases, changes made to a vehicle by a vehicle mod need to be tracked to meet design needs.
Such changes are tracked and used here. It is provided as an actor component so that any replication needs are easily handled.
eg instead of continuously spawning BGAs, reapplying a mod can heal already spawned BGAs to avoid spawning overhead.
In general this component should track data, rather than modifying vehicle handling logic.
One component is spawned for each applied mod using the vehicle mod config system.

UObjectToolTips.ObjectiveUpdateGate_RollingTimer:
Rolling Objective Timer Gate
This gate type will time stamp objective updates as they occur, and when checks for CanProgressQuestObjective are called
it will purge updates that are older than the specified Timespan for objective updates, and change the objective count based on current updates
This works as a rolling timer for quests that are to do x things in y seconds that don't have a triggering condition to start the timer.
Example: Pickup 5 objects in 8 seconds.
Timeline: 0.0 pickup item 1, 2.0 pickup item 2, 5.0 pickup item 3, 7.0 pickup item 4, 9.0 pickup item five (item 1 update is reset, current count is 4), 9.5 pickup item 6 (count is 5, quest finishes)

Runtime debugger for the Gameplay Conditionals system. Server-spawned and owner-only replicated.

The server records a per-conditional timeline of triggered/updated/failed events into the
UGameplayConditionalSubsystem and, each replication cycle, packs a bounded snapshot of the
inventory plus the selected and global timelines down to the owning client, which renders them
through ImGui. See https://pthom.github.io/imgui_manual_online/manual/imgui_manual.html for ImGui examples.

UObjectToolTips.FortPlayerPawn:EmoteRandomSeed: 每次表情开始时都会在拥有的客户端上滚动种子（并复制到所有客户端），所以那些表情/动画通知可以得出相同的 " 随机 " 结果（卡牌颜色、蒙太奇部分，道具变体）适用于每个客户端，而不是每个客户端独立随机化。服务器启动表情（分组结果、作弊）在服务器端滚动种子。0 = 没有激活的表情种子。通过读取GetEmoteRandomSeed()。重要-把它放在pawn上，在 LastReplicatedEmoteExecuted (AFortPawn)旁边：模拟代理重播来自 OnRep_LastReplicatedEmoteExecuted, 的表情，那个 onRep 就是触发的读取此种子的通知。因为这两个属性都住在同一个Actor身上，所以它们到达了同样的复制群，UE 会在触发任何 OnRep 之前应用一组中的所有属性-这可以保证通知运行时种子已经存在。不要把它移到AbilitySystemComponent/PlayerState（一个单独的Actor通道）；这打破了顺序而且重新引入了为修复而添加的每个客户端的不同步问题。

UObjectToolTips.FortAnimNode_CachedSequenceEvaluator:
Sequence evaluator that caches the extracted pose by name in a per-ABP subsystem
(FFortAnimSubsystem_PoseCache), making it available to all nodes in the same ABP
instance — including linked graphs and self layers — without re-evaluating
GetAnimationPose.

Cache validity is checked per-evaluate against (Sequence, Time, LOD, bone count,
bone-container serial number). Any change in those parameters causes the named
slot to be refreshed.

If CacheName is None or the subsystem is unavailable, the node falls back to
evaluating the pose directly each frame without caching.

Root-motion extraction is not supported.
All sync-group, ExplicitTime/ExplicitFrame, and teleport settings are inherited
from FAnimNode_SequenceEvaluator.

            1) call UBuildingPoolHarvestResourceSpawnsComponent::FindOrAddBuildingPoolHarvestResourceSpawnsComponent() to find or create the necessary component.

UObjectToolTips.MonologueEvent:
可共享的数据，代表某个时间点上值得注意的事件，无论大小，例如：播放了一段声音、天空中出现一艘飞船、
某个角色说了些什么。然后，使用匹配的UMonologueEventDescriber，利用源数据向所有“感知”到该事件的角色“描述”此事件。重要的是，这允许每个角色以不同的方式感知同一个事件，例如：声音事件可以针对远处的角色描述为
“你隐约听到脚步声”，针对近处的角色描述为“你听到响亮的脚步声。他们一定就在附近。”这些事件可以通过UMonologueComponent::PerceiveEvent直接发送到 UMonologueComponent，也可以通过
UMonologueSubsystem::PropagateEvent “传播” 给所有角色@see UMonologueEventDescriber, FMonologuePerceivedEvent

Should an NPC start chattering as soon as it is spawned?

Off by default, which leaves the moment chatter comes to life up to the project: the NPC adopts these
settings when it spawns either way, but waits to be told when to start, so a derived chatter component
can begin at whatever point its own logic calls for - an encounter starting, a door opening, a phase
change. Turn it on for NPCs that should simply chatter from the moment they exist.

Read by UNPCChatterBaseComponent, which calls its own Initialize when this is set.

UObjectToolTips.QuestVisibilityData:bIsVisibleWhenClaime:
Should the quest be visible when claimed?

A quest is "Completed" if it was finished in this match and MCP hasn't been updated yet.
A quest is then "Claimed" once MCP has been updated with the completed quest.

In practice, "Is Visible When Completed" decides if we show the completed quest in-game
(before the postmatch screen and before the periodic MCP updates in games like Odyssey),
and "Is Visible When Claimed" decides if we show the completed afterwards (e.g. postmatch
and in the frontend.)
UObjectToolTips.QuestVisibilityData:bIsVisibleWhenComple:

A quest is "Completed" if it was finished in this match and MCP hasn't been updated yet.

In practice, "Is Visible When Completed" decides if we show the completed quest in-game
(before the postmatch screen and before the periodic MCP updates in games like Odyssey),
and "Is Visible When Claimed" decides if we show the completed afterwards (e.g. postmatch

Useful when profiling big anim graphs, to be able to easily identify the cost of an specific sub-graph.

Example:
Loco State Machine ---> Profiler Stat Event (this node) ---> More nodes -> Final Pose Node
In Unreal Insights you should see something like:
- Entries for all the nodes from the Output Node backwards... (keep in mind only the nodes with SCOPE_COUNTERS will appear)
- STAT_Profiler Stat Event <--- This is the mark from this node, with 'ProfilerEventName' at the end (There will be a mark during the Initialization Phase, Update Phase and Evaluation Phase)
- Loco State Machine
- Entries inside the state machine
The cost of the Profiler Stat Event (this node) will give us an estimate of the cost of that entire state machine

Single always-relevant actor replicating the set of quest category descriptors to every
client. Spawned server-side by UFortQuestCategoryRegistrySubsystem when the first category is
registered. Quest views arrive independently of descriptors (no cross-actor ordering
guarantee), so clients must tolerate views that reference a not-yet-known CategoryId and
re-home them when the descriptor lands.

must still tolerate a previously-known descriptor disappearing.

SlateIM debug tab for the Juno per-(NPC, player) relationship system.

Lists every NPC with relationship state (live or persisted-only). Each NPC expands to one section per
player exposing:
  - Current level tag.
  - A data-driven "Set" button per ladder level, and a "Reset" button (clears the player's entry).
  - A per-condition breakdown of the CURRENT gate (each WC row's live result + each verb row's latch),
    with a Latch / Unlatch toggle on verb conditions, so you can see exactly what is blocking advancement.
  - A change log of recent transitions / latches.
Also draws a one-frame world-space label above each NPC with the LOCAL player's level, higher on Z than
the happiness label so the two don't overlap.
UObjectToolTips.JunoAIHappinessDebuggerMenu:
SlateIM debug tab for the Juno villager happiness system.

Lists every villager with a FSavedAIData_Happiness entry (live or persisted-only).
Per row exposes:
  - Full UniqueAIIdentifier + Value + state tag (gradient-coloured by tier rank).
  - +10 / -10 / Set 0 buttons.
  - Per verb row: HappinessChange / CooldownRealTimeHours / RequiredEveryRealTimeHours / UnfulfilledValue / last-fire UTC / Fire / Reset.
  - Per ongoing requirement: FulfilledValue / UnfulfilledValue / current State / Flip.
  - Recent changes ring buffer with timestamp, source, row, delta, old / new, instigator.
UObjectToolTips.JunoVillagerJobDebuggerMenu:
SlateIM debug tab for the villager job system (legacy gatherer rows + bespoke loot tables).

Lists every NPC with job data (live or persisted-only). Each NPC expands to:
  - Role and current job: the generators of its camp it can use right now (real
    UJunoPassiveResourcesGatheringComponent::CanGenerate checks) with their resolved registry
    job row, pacing (with the debug GenerationTimeMultiplier applied) and roll configs.
  - The persisted accruals, collections since the last player interaction, held generated items
    and pity counters. NPCs on the legacy path are marked [legacy] and show their legacy row.
Also draws one-frame world-space labels: above each gatherer NPC (last generated %) and above
every generator actor within distance of the local view (its resolved job row, via the component's
real resolution logic; no logic is duplicated in this tool).

UObjectToolTips.FortVehicleModComponent:CollisionLocalSt:
Static meshes that are spawned on the client and server.
These are necessary for welding collision shapes for physics.

These pointers are currently not consistent for replicated variables or RPCs.
There is some complexity about name re-usage with making these net-addressible by unique name,
so for now, refer to query these meshes via their index in the mod config

Any component that is not the root component of an actor, is not considered for component movements.
This means, if we attach a static mesh with collision to a vehicle, it won't affect vehicle handling.
The way to have a mesh affect vehicle handling (ie changing its collision), is by welding it to the vehicle.
This allows us to add additional collision shapes. But note that this is precarious.
 If a shape is added and not welded, intra-collisions can push the vehicle off into the sky as it repeatedly collides with components on itself.

 DO NOT EXPOSE TO BLUEPRINT DIRECTLY. To avoid adding complexity for designer and refactoring, if exposing to blueprint create a query UFUNCTION instead.

UObjectToolTips.MashDifficultyModifierData:
Struct containing data used with DifficultyModifierGE to modify AI attributes (health/damage) based on difficulty level.
When the GE is applied to AI on spawn, magnitude of the modifiers are set with SetSetByCallerMagnitude using the
SetByCallerTag and the calculated magnitude based on the multipliers. The multipliers are looked up based on the
current difficulty level and player count.
Eg, the DifficultyModifierGE could have a damage modifier setup using SetByCaller and tag SetByCaller.Damage. DifficultyModifierData array
would contain an entry of this struct with the same SetByCallerTag and look up table rows for damage multipliers based on the difficulty level and the player count.

UObjectToolTips.FortGameplayCueNotify_Loop:
这将替代FortGameplayCueNotify_Looping
 这是所有循环播放、基于持续时间的提示的标准Fort GamePlay提示通知。任何具有持续时间的内容：由游戏（而非Gameplay提示的资产）明确定义开始和结束时间的内容，都应使用该类。该类中可以内置其他功能。任何标准且易于完全用数据定义的内容，均是理想的候选对象。任何新增
内容都应属于“应用/循环/重复/删除”类别。（例如，不要创建新的类别或将内容放在
该类的现有结构之外）。该类中的命名方式与Gameplay提示系统的其余部分略有不同。例如，WhileActive在该类中被称为循环。之所以选择这些名字，是因为它们对开发团队中的特效创作者来说最有意义。所有面向设计师的功能都应使用这些名称。

UObjectToolTips.FortQuestCategoryDescriptor:ParentCatego:
The CategoryId of the category this one is listed under -- the authored Parent link, not a
placement guarantee (a record naming an unmaterialized parent routes to the default bucket
client-side until the parent's record appears).
Naming a category here is what makes THAT category a tab. Only ever one level deep: the UI reads a
category and this id, and never follows the parent's own ParentCategoryId to place this record.
Empty by default, which clients read as "no descriptor has arrived yet". Descriptors published by
UFortQuestCategoryRegistrySubsystem::RegisterCategory instead carry
FortQuestPresentation::DefaultQuestTabId (the built-in Quests tab) whenever no parent is honored:
the field is unset, the reflection read fails, or the named parent is not a fort_quest_category
(dropped with a Warning). Only the NAMED PARENT's type is gated here; the publishing category's
own type is the caller convention on RegisterCategory, so an engine quest_category registered
past that convention still carries whatever its inherited Parent yields, fort parent included.
One exception replicates on the wire: a fort category naming ITSELF as Parent carries its own
CategoryId here rather than the sentinel (an engine-typed self-reference is dropped by the
non-fort parent gate first, keeps the sentinel, and never reaches the self-reference Warning);
the UI drops the self-edge when building that tab's sections, and the publish walk ignores it.

UObjectToolTips.FortControllerComponent_AugmentGrantingS:
The Component responsible for augment granting.

//#todo #augments matt.stone revisit this after we have finalized and make sure the comment is true to the actual system.
High level how it works:
        Server
                The server is authoritative on what augments a player can choose.
                        For prototyping, there is a passive GA that randomly chooses augment choices, and gives them to this component for the flow to start.
                        This is pending change, but perhaps it is a good high level way to let design configure augment granting, while leaving most business logic to code.
                It will replicate down to the client the choices it can make, and how many augments it has available.
        Client
                Client gets notified it has available augments and enters a granting flow.
                With augments available, the client can use input to start a selection process, where they pick the augment they want from the available choices.
                        this is currently done via a weapon item; which lets us configure camera modes, etc, while in the augment grant mode.
                Client confirms the choice and lets the server know via server RPC; the server validates and replicates new data to the client.
                Client updates it flow state based on the replicated data from the server (eg new choices, number of pending granting augments)

This AugmentGrantingSystem is intentionally decoupled from the augment component.
Thoughts on the decoupling into separate systems:
        benefits:
                Decoupling keeps the augment system separate from logic granting augments, leading to a more flexible system.
                Decoupling allows us to support different schemes of augment granting without muddying up the actual augment system with code related to obtaining.
                Decoupling allows us to have multiple granting schemes, if needed in the future. It may make sense to have multiple schemes here. But this focuses on choosing from a selection of augments.
                Decoupling means if players obtaining augments via a boss drop in the world, picking up that augment will be separate from this granting management.
                Decoupling means we can have weighted loot tables making augments available, or something else entirely providing the selection of augments available.
                The spytech system was previous investigated for augments, but found that the coupling to round based granting logic made it less flexible (there were other issues as well, such as the type of items spytech was).
                Decoupling means creative can leverage augments without the granting logic; since they will be using their own custom logic.
        negatives:
                it might be slightly more involved to figure out what you need to modify if a change is needed (but I think it shouldn't be too bad, as this keeps classes small).
                we have multiple components where as we could have only 1 without decoupling.
                it could get involved if different components have bad interactions, and need to make components interact with each other (realistically though I think not, since granting augment is done via inventory, these components will hopefully be mutually exclusive).
.

UObjectToolTips.ObjectiveFilter:
The FObjectiveFilter baseclass represents the must-have aspects of any objective filter.  The things common between
all objective filters is that there will Always be an Author that an objective will relate to.
For example, if you shoot someone, 'you' are the instigator of the objective. Inversely if the objective
is Take Damage, and 'you' take damage, you are the instigator for taking damage, even though you are not
the necessarily the damage causer.

together. Filters may have other types of conditions that might relate to certain subjects, but each subject
filter will always provide one instance of this to be used to filter against the subject in the processor.

UObjectToolTips.NPCChatterBaseUserOptionsComponent:
The chatter settings an island author sees, read by the NPCs the spawner produces.

This is how chatter shows up as extra options on an otherwise chatter-agnostic spawner: the component
is injected onto the spawner by a project's own game feature, so its options appear in the details panel
only in the projects that ship the injection. Nothing in the shared spawner knows chatter exists.

The authored values reach these properties through the base's property-override channel - UserOptionData
is replicated and applied over the class defaults - so this component can simply be read.

Deriving from UFortUserOptionContainerComponent rather than plain UActorComponent is what makes the
options render at all: the definitions are generated in UFortUserOptionContainerComponent::PostCDOCompiled,
a Blueprint compile hook. Two consequences worth knowing before wondering why the panel is empty:
  - a native class is never CDO-compiled, so this must be subclassed as a Blueprint and the BP's
    generated class is what a game feature injects;
  - that hook only scans the exact class being compiled, so the BP needs
    bRecurseBaseClassesForUserOptions ticked (or hand-authored Definitions) to see the properties
    declared here on the native base.

This class is nothing but the settings - it holds data and has no behaviour of its own. The NPCs read it;
it does not go looking for them. The spawner announces each NPC it makes through IFortSpawnableInterface,
and the NPC reads these settings off it from there, so all of the doing lives on the pawn side in
UNPCChatterBaseComponent.

The full FFortWorldMarkerData class provides too many opportunities for a bad actor
to replicate bad information to other clients since we trust the client a lot of generating
marker data, therefore the FFortClientMarkerRequest minimizes that risk by only sending the
most basic of marker info, and then it's on the onus of the server to rebuild the correct marker
data to replicate from the clients by using the actor to determine what data it needs.

UObjectToolTips.GlobalVariableModifier_AddInt32Value:Val:
要添加到现有变量值的整数值

使用FGameplayProviderNumerical支持固定值和动态值：

固定值示例：
- ValueToAdd = FixedValue(1) - 始终递增1
- ValueToAdd = FixedValue(-10) - 始终递减10
- ValueToAdd = FixedValue(100) - 始终增加100点

动态值示例：
- ValueToAdd = GlobalVariable(BonusMultiplier) - 从另一个变量添加值
- ValueToAdd = MathOperation(WaveNumber * 5) - 随游戏进程缩放
- ValueToAdd = Conditional(HasBonus ? 50 : 10) - 上下文相关奖励
- ValueToAdd = RandomRange(-5, 5) - 添加随机方差

负值：
使用负值可以做减法，无需单独的“减法”修改器：
- 添加-1以递减计数器
- 对生命值添加负伤害（替代单独的伤害系统）
- 对惩罚或成本添加负值

默认为FixedValue(0.0)，添加0（无变化）。

UObjectToolTips.FortWeaponRanged:AimPitchMax:
The maximum aim pitch allowed.
     Limits how high a shot can be fired. Could be used for a mortar style weapon and/or and can prevent shots from being fired straight up or even backwards.
     This can ensure that projectiles are fired with a heading that is near the camera's/muzzle's forward heading.
     (Common situations where a projectile's heading is far from expectations: 1) If the weapon is aimed very near straight up/down where a small amount of spread can radically change the projectile heading, or 2) Where ProjectilePitchOffset can cause the projectile to be fired at a pitch more than 90 degrees from 0 which essentially reverses the heading.)
     For projectile weapons: when aim pitch is clamped ProjectilePitchOffset is taken into account before clamping.
     Set >= 180 to disable.
     Data validation will fail is NOT AimPitchMin <= AimPitchMax.

UObjectToolTips.FortWeaponRanged:AimPitchMin:
The minimum aim pitch allowed.
     Limits how low a shot can be fired. Could be used for a mortar style weapon and/or can prevent shots from being fired straight down or even backwards.
     This can ensure that projectiles are fired with a heading that is near the camera's/muzzle's forward heading.
     (Common situations where a projectile's heading is far from expectations: 1) If the weapon is aimed very near straight up/down where a small amount of spread can radically change the projectile heading, or 2) Where ProjectilePitchOffset can cause the projectile to be fired at a pitch more than 90 degrees from 0 which essentially reverses the heading.)
     For projectile weapons: when aim pitch is clamped ProjectilePitchOffset is taken into account before clamping.
     Set <= -180 to disable.
     Data validation will fail is NOT AimPitchMin <= AimPitchMax.

UObjectToolTips.GlobalVariableModifier_SetInt32Value:New:
用于设置变量的新整数值

使用FGameplayProviderNumerical 支持固定值和动态值：

固定值示例（设计时）：
- NewValue = FixedValue(100) - 始终将变量设置为100

动态值示例（运行时）：
- NewValue = GlobalVariable(ScoreTag) - 从另一个变量复制值
- NewValue = MathOperation(CurrentValue * 2) - 将现有值翻倍
- NewValue = RandomRange(1, 10) - 设置为随机值

要修改相对于当前值的现有值：
-选项1：使用AddInt32Value修改器（对加法/减法来说更简单）
- 选项2：使用含数学运算的提供器：MathOperation (GlobalVariable (myTag) + 10)

默认为FixedValue (0.0)这会将变量设置为0。

UObjectToolTips.FortEventReaction_UpdateNumericVariable::
用于乘以更新量的数值提供器

仅在bUseMultiplier为true时使用。提供器在反应时间进行评估
其结果与条件差量相乘。公式：FinalAmount = Delta * MultiplierValue（均为双精度，全精度）

常见乘数模式：
- FixedValue(2.0) - 将差量翻倍
- FixedValue(0.5) - 将差量减半
- FixedValue(1.25) - 应用125%的delta（25%加成）
- GlobalVariable(EventMultiplier) - 按事件加成进行缩放
- MathOperation(1.0 + BonusPercent) - 加法奖励计算

注意：所有计算都保留双精度 - 不会截断。示例：差量=0.125 *  乘数=1.5 = 0.1875（精确结果）
UObjectToolTips.FortEventReaction_UpdateInt32Variable:Nu:
用于乘以更新量的数值提供器

仅在bUseMultiplier为true时使用。提供器在反应时间进行评估
其结果与条件差量相乘。公式：FinalAmount = static_cast<int32>(Delta * MultiplierValue)

常见乘数模式：
- FixedValue(2.0) - 将差量翻倍
- FixedValue(0.5) - 将差量减半
- GlobalVariable(DifficultyMultiplier) - 按难度缩放
- 条件提供器 - 基于条件的不同乘数
- MathOperation(TeamSize)与倒数 - 在团队中分配

注意：差量和乘数结果都将转换为int32，截断小数。
示例：差量=10.7 * 乘数=1.5 = 16.05 → 16 (int32)

UObjectToolTips.GlobalVariableModifier_Int32MathOperatio:
数学运算的操作数值

使用FGameplayProviderNumerical支持固定和动态操作数：

固定值示例：
- OperandValue = FixedValue(2) - 翻倍（乘法）或减半（除法）
- OperandValue = FixedValue(10) - 缩放10倍（乘法）或循环0-9（取模）
- OperandValue = FixedValue(4) - 将值减为四分之一（除以4）

动态值示例：
- OperandValue = GlobalVariable(DifficultyMultiplier) - 按难度缩放
- OperandValue = MathOperation(PlayerCount) - 除以玩家数量
- OperandValue = Conditional(IsHardMode ? 3 : 2) - 上下文相关的缩放

安全注意事项：
- 对于除法/模数：零操作数会被安全处理（保留原值并记录警告）
- 对于乘法：大值可能溢出（标准C++整数回绕）

默认为FixedValue(1.0)乘以1（无变化）、除以1（无变化）
或对1取模（结果始终为0）。

UObjectToolTips.ApplyWrapVariantDef:MetaTags:
The set of meta tags this variant specifies.
Used in LTMs which want to apply custom part overrides (Wick/Bounty)

MetaTags are applied with the main cosmetic definition tags as a base.
Any currently active MetaTags can either add additional tags or remove tags.
All active variants can remove/add tags (processed in a loop)

Use Cases:
             Variant of Peely with a painted-on suit.
                     (Remove ExtremelyUnique, add Assassin)
                     Results in Bounty leaving the skin alone (ignore that we do that anyway).

             Variant of Reaper, but he's wearing golf attire (or something).
                     (Remove Assassin)
                     Results in Bounty forcing that variant into a suit (as per any other outfit).
                     Reaper's primary variant would keep his suit.

@see MetaTags on the main cosmetic item definition (scroll up).

UObjectToolTips.ScriptedActionVariantDef:MetaTags:
该变体指定的元标签集合。用于希望应用自定义部件重载（威克/赏金）的LTM

元标签的应用以主外观定义标签为基础。任何当前激活的元标签都可以添加额外的标签或移除标签。所有激活的变体都可以移除/添加标签（在循环中处理）

用例：
             穿着彩绘套装的蕉宝变体。（移除ExtremelyUnique，添加Assassin）
导致赏金不会对皮肤做任何改动（忽略我们本身也会这么做）。收割者的变体，但他穿着高尔夫球服装（或类似装扮）。（移除Assassin）
                     导致赏金强制该变体穿上一套衣服（根据任何其他服装）。收割者的主要变体将维持原有套装。@see 主外观物品定义上的元标签（向上滚动）。

UObjectToolTips.FortEventReaction_ModifyTagContainer:Tag:
要添加、移除或设置的标签

解译取决于操作：
- **添加**：将这些标签添加到现有容器中
- **移除**：将这些标签从容器中移除（如有）
- **设置**：将容器完全替换为这些标签
- **清除**：该字段将被忽略（容器将被清空）

可以包含多个标签，用于批量操作：
- 添加{"Buff.Strength", "Buff.Speed"}同时授予两种增益
- 移除{"Debuff.Slowed", "Debuff.Weakened"}清除多个减益
- 设置{"Permission.View", "Permission.Edit"}设定准确的权限

示例：
- 授予伤害增益：使用标签{"Buff.Damage.Tier1"}执行添加操作
- 移除中毒效果：使用标签{"Status.Poison"}执行移除操作
- 设置管理员权限：使用标签{"Perm.Admin", "Perm.Edit", "Perm.Delete"}设置操作

These are the settings of service. The settings are used to initialize the service. They are also used to uniquely identify a
service inside the persistence framework. The framework can have more than instance of the same class of service wrappers as long as
their settings are different.
So a service wrapper inside the persistence framework is uniquely identified by combination of its class and its settings.
For example in the case of inventory you can have many wrappers, as long as they all have a different VK project ID, which is their setting.

In this example I am just using a simple setting of a FString.

UObjectToolTips.PlayspaceComponent_DispatchExternallyRea:
This PlayspaceComponent is part of the 'InferPlayspaceReachability' system, and exists to signal to external code that the Playspace it exists within is now "Externally Discoverable".

Add this component to your Playspace when you want to use WaitForDiscoverablePlayspaceWithFilterAction / GameStateComponent_ListenForExternallyReachablePlayspaces.

A Playspace is "Externally Discoverable" on the server when it has been inserted into the Playspace Tree (OnPlayspaceCreatedAndReady).
A Playspace is "Externally Discoverable" on the clients when the Parent Playspace (on the client) has had its ChildPlayspace array replicated to include the new Child Playspace (or if it is known to be the RootPlayspace of the Playspace Manager).

In other words, if you start from RootPlayspace->GetChildPlayspaces()... and were to recursively append all GetChildPlayspaces arrays into a single array, then a Playspace is "Externally Discoverable" if it exists in that array (or is the root).

This component type handles all of this for you, on either Servers or Clients, and provides a statically available delegate for when any Playspace (which has this component) first becomes Externally Discoverable.

@See UWaitForDiscoverablePlayspaceWithFilterAction
@See UGameStateComponent_ListenForExternallyReachablePlayspaces

UObjectToolTips.FortBroadcastRemoteClientInfo:
This allows us to send information which would usually only exist on a particular client to multiple broadcast spectators.

The main use case of this is to allow us to take UI and gameplay elements which would normally only be visible to just the
single local player, and show them from a broadcast client. (Structure previews/editing, interaction timers etc)

Obviously we do not want to be sending massive amounts of information unnecessarily, so this class should only be doing work
when 1 or more broadcast spectators are currently watching the player this remote client info represents. We also have to be
careful what we add to this.

This class should only be relevant for replication to it's owned player, and any currently viewing broadcaster. This logic
is handled in the replication graph.

UObjectToolTips.SkyfireTODOverrideVolume:
This class represents a 'null' gameplay volume which will house a FortVolumeTimeOfDayComponent. The TOD component
will be enabled/disabled by manually broadcasting player entered/exited events from SkyfireControllerComponent and
will not be enabled/disabled by any actor/player actually entering or exiting the volume. Though this class implements
IFortSpatialGameplayInterface, it does not provide useful implementations of the functions in that interface as it
is meant to act as a volume with infinitely small bounds (i.e. a 'null' volume).

The reason this class is necessary is that in order for FortVolumeTimeOfDayComponents to work properly, they must be
attached to a GameplayVolume actor that implements IFortSpatialGameplayInterface. Skyfire cannot use the typical FortVolume
that is used by other TOD components because the TOD will automatically enable/disable based on if the player is inside
the volume.

When an elimination occurs, the Driver will log it down, and then use a series of Evaluators to determine how interesting the elimination is
Each evaluator will judge the elimination based off the player's Log, and the elimination information available
Each evaluator will judge the elimination and give it a score based off what they are interested in, and when such a highlight clip should start and stop
Evaluators combine their assessment of an EvaluatedElimination, and a highlight clip is created from it
Highlight clips are saved to a players log. Any highlight clips that are close together get merged together
At the end of the game, the server extracts an significant highlights according to what BaseHighlightExtractors are enabled
Highlight extractors make new highlight clips, or look at existing ones and say "I don't care about the score, this is an important clip!"
The server gathers all highlight clips from all players, and sorts them based off score (what the evaluators say about an interesting kill) and significance (what the Extractors say)
The top N game highlights are made into replay camera shots, and saved to the replay file

UObjectToolTips.FortPhysicsPickup:
This is a pickup class that uses simulated physics for movement, instead of the projectile movement component.
In order to use this (assuming using from a plugin), the following is needed...

1. Create a custom BP pickup class.
2. Add an "Override Pickup Class" Game Feature Action to force the game to use a different pick up class.
3. Create a FortPhysicsObjectPreset asset in your plugin to be used by your physics pickup.
4. Create a UFortPhysicsObjectPreset asset in your plugin to be used by your physics pickup.
5. Added a "Physics Object Setup Data" Game Feature Action to your plugin and configure to point at the two previous assets you created.
6. Update your pickup BP class "Physics Object Tag" properties to point at the tags you referenced in the previous step.

UObjectToolTips.FortVersionedSparseClassData:
This struct is to be used in any sparse class data structs that want to support
      versioning for moving data into the sparse class data more than once.  In order
      to use this, subclasses will need to define the following static const inline...

      static const inline FFortSparseClassDataVersionInfo VersionInfo{TEXT("MyStructName"), 1};

      As well, you will need to add the function in the classes that use the versioned sparse class data...

      FORTNITEGAME_API virtual void MoveDataToSparseClassDataStructCustom(bool bIsSaving = false) const;

      This function will need to be called in MoveDataToSparseClassDataStruct, passing in false. And also
      called in PreSave, passing in true.

      To ensure versioned data migrates between related struct types, Conform must be called by the class implementation of:

      virtual bool ConformSparseClassDataStruct(UScriptStruct* const SourceSparseClassDataStruct, void* SourceSparseClassData) const override;

      NOTE:   The copy constructors are explicitly NOT copying any data. This ensures data from this struct is NEVER copied
                      from a class archetype instance. This data NEEDS to be unique per UClass instance. If this is not true,
                      this struct will not properly control when sparse class data does or does NOT copy data from deprecated class properties.
                      The only time version data should be copied is during ConformSparseClassDataStruct, when it calls Conform.

      Each time a child class adds more data, it will need to increase the version number in the VersionInfo.
      For an example of how to use this, please look at ABuildingActor and FBuildingActorClassData, along with
      all of it's subclasses.  For further questions, please reach out to @andrew.thayer.

UObjectToolTips.FortEvenlySizedSegment:
This structure contains a list of evenly sized segments, meaning their end points are roughly "evenly spaced" along the trail constituted by the PathToDestination points.
It also contains the necessary info for calculating and setting up the associated spline mesh and its associated collision.
This is not replicated.  It is written to be initialized and kept only on the client as the client received points in PathToDestination from the server.
While the points that make up the spline are meant to be static, there is some handling of interpolation of the end point, growth alphas, etc.

This structure can also be thought of as representing a section of the spline the length of EvenlySpacedPointsDistance (defined in AFortSplineGroundPath)

Trace Type used to determine the behavior when we hit an actor with the 'Ignore Tag' present
SingleTrace: The node will run a single collision test. If we hit an actor with the 'Ignore Tag' the result will be treated as an invalid hit
MultiTrace: If the first collision test hits an actor with the 'Ignore Tag' present, we will run another another trace to try to find a valid hit below.
If this second trace fails or if it also hits an actor with the tag, we will consider the hit invalid too.

UObjectToolTips.EPoseBuilderPoseState: 姿势的三状态启用。通过右键点击齿轮按钮进行循环。- 激活：正常评估，写入输出，尊重滑条/重载。- 输出禁用：不计算驱动骨骼/曲线/操作，并且不将姿势的贡献写入驱动骨骼——但会保留用户的PoseBlendWeights/ActivatedPoseBlendSlots/FullActivationHistory条目，因此重新启用会恢复之前的滑条状态。- 非激活：与OutputDisabled相同的跳过行为，加上姿势的滑条/重载状态在进入时重设为零。在此状态下，姿势行的展开详情将完全隐藏。
UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderKeyPose:PoseState: 启用三态姿势。用三个不同的级别替换旧的 bDisabled布尔：Active = 完整评估 + 输出；outputDisabled = 跳过评估和输出，保留用户的滑块/覆盖值；非活动 = 跳过所有内容并重置滑块/重写为零。齿轮按钮通过右键单击来循环切换。

UObjectToolTips.FortAttachableProjectileComponent:
UFortAttachableProjectileComponent:
Component to support projectiles that attach to their target. The attachment must be initiated by the projectile's
authority calling AuthorityAttachToActor typically in blueprint in response to the OnTouched event. The the attachment
params are replicated to other nodes. The exact attachment location is determined separately on each client based on
the hit location and the client's animation state. The attachment location on the server will be the target's origin.
This component can be used with AFortProjectileBase (which does uses the server side capsule collision volume for
initial hit detection), or the newer AFortProjectileAthena (which offers more precise hit detection using the owning
player's mesh collision volume). Any other actor class with a ProjectileMovementComponent can utilize this component
for basic projectile attachment functionality.
The logic for this component is mostly ported from AFortAttachableProjectileDeprecated, which is now deprecated in
favor of this component. The motivation for pulling the logic into a component was to allow it to be shared amongst
different projectile actor types.
Note that if we notice attachment latency especially with client side predicted or athena projectiles, we can refine
this algorithm. All attachment is initiated server side at the moment.

UObjectToolTips.ETasksOverFramesSchedulePriorityCategory:
UTasksOverFramesScheduleManager.cpp: A manager to split work over multiple
frames to reduce frame hitches.  Any function can be added to this queue
and it will be called back based when frame time is available, likely within
a few frames.

NOTE: All functions queued via this manager will appear as part of CharacterCustomization in Perf reports
for the time being. Contact #fn-pi-cosmetics-tech-ext if that is undesired for your use case.

The manager uses a priority queue to decide on what to work on next.
Priority is determined by a Category (feel free to add more) and a
SubPriority     within that Priority.  The SubPriority can be different
depending on the category.  For some it might be based on how visible
something is to the camera for example, for others some other heuristic might
be used.

There are various ways to configure TasksOverFramesScheduleManager with CVars.
See CVars in the CPP.

Note the complexity of this class is the result of trying to make sure we cover future use
such as cases:
 - Reentrant functions where a callback tries to do work in a callback
 - Lifetime of objects who own the function pointer
 - Making sure we don't accidentally skip a callback call by replacing it
 - Doing work immediately if we are still within the budget so we can see things a frame
 - earlier
 - Preventing users from accidentally making a copy of the handle

UObjectToolTips.LootInjectionOptionRow:UpgradesAtTokenCo:
Upgrade track for this loot option.
When a player hits the key token count, they will gain a "level" in the specified upgrade.
This is cumulative, so the player has all the upgrades on the track that they have unlocked previously at lower token counts.
Example:
2, SpawnChance
4, SpawnChance
8, Rarity
At token count 1, the player will have unlocked this loot option using the base LTG and base spawn chance.
At 2 and 3, they will have level 1 upgraded spawn chance, using SpawnChanceUpgrades[0] instead of the base spawn chance.
At 4 - 7, they will have level 2 upgraded spawn chance (SpawnChanceUpgrades[1])
At 8, they will have level 2 upgraded spawn chance (SpawnChanceUpgrades[1]) AND level 1 rarity upgrade (RarityUpgrades[0])

UObjectToolTips.FortMovementComp_Character:FallingSlopeS:
When hitting a slope this angle or shallower, it's safe to slide on. Apply falling damage (if any) and reset falling height to player location at time of impact.
Steeper slopes than this angle do not cause damage until the player hits a harder impact or lands (so will do more damage at the bottom).
If you want generous sliding, set the angle to be high. Sliding commences and continues to reset the height until landing.
Falls from a high altitude will still damage you on impact of the slope if it is shallower.
(Note: 0 = horizontal, 90 = vertical. 0 disables this behavior. 90 allows sliding down any slope for no damage. Characters can normally walk up slopes < 45 degrees).

UObjectToolTips.QuestInstanceInitializationData:
When qs2 quest managers grant and initialize a new quest instance, all properties from this data bundle (taken post-initialization)
will be replicated from the server quest instance and injected back into the client quest instance as part of its creation and initialization
This allows us to guarantee certain data will be present on a client quest instance before any post-creation logic executes

When set to true allows downward tension to be added on deflection and eased every tick. Downward tension is built up when the projectile gains downward velocity after a deflection, downward tension will add upward velocity to the projectile over time; might be useful to minimize jumping curbs in uncommon gravity situations.
     Turning this on can cause the projectile to build up suspension while sliding on the ground and cause it to jump, especially if a lot of gravity gets dumped into the velocity during a fire rate spike.
     If disabled tension will not update nor build in the downward direction. Tension will ease every frame as long as bSuspensionEnabled_Up or bSuspensionEnabled_Down is enabled.

When set to true allows upward tension to be added on deflection and eased every tick. Upward tension is built up when the projectile gains upward velocity after a deflection, upward tension will add downward velocity to the projectile over time; this is a good way to minimize jumping curbs.
     If disabled tension will not update nor build in the upward direction. Tension will ease every frame as long as bSuspensionEnabled_Up or bSuspensionEnabled_Down is enabled.

UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderKeyPose:bStatic: 当为true时，姿势被视为始终开启的基线校正。跳过所有驱动器评估——DriverBones / DriverCurveEntries / Operations / PoseWeightVariable被忽略，姿势在每个tick时以全强度应用。镜像ModifyTransforms_PerItem / SetTransform / ParentConstraint的源骨骼模式，使用字面值Weight=1.0并且没有Weight引脚连线——这些节点在运行时无条件触发。评估顺序：静态姿势在每个tick的常规（驱动器评估）通过之前应用。任何驱动相同骨骼层的非静态姿势都在静态结果之上，而不是相反——静态值是驱动器姿势混合的基线。请参阅FRigUnit_PoseBuilder_Execute。

UObjectToolTips.PoseBuilderOperation:bDebugEnabled: 当为 true 时，运行时会绘制此操作的流形（距离箭头/AxisProjection射线/等），而姿势的正常模式流形可见性规则允许。默认为 false，因此新的反序列化操作（包括公共操作、参考操作、而且从旧存档中加载的操作）一开始就隐藏了流形。在PoseBuilderAssetDetails_DriverOps.cpp 中，添加操作的路径会明确将此标志设为 true，用于面向用户的私有操作类型（Distance、AxisProjection）；引用操作保持 false；公共操作提升也保持 false（因为当手动激活的消费姿态引用公共操作时，运行时会自动显示其操作流形，因此默认关闭眼睛切换，以减少视口杂乱）。

When using auto property path generation to generate path to a property that's either inside a map or an array.
We expect to have a valid index for that property to be added to this map via AddGeneratePathPropertyNestedIndexData
Example lets say you are looking for property bCount for Objective 2 the path would be Objectives[2]->bCount
Auto generation how ever doesn't know it has to look for Index = 2. So in this case we need to specify that for Property Objectives we are looking for Index 2

Whether one of content's dates - go-live or expiry - could be worked out, and if not, whether that is permanent.

The distinction that matters: the client only sees calendar events while they are active, so a date measured
from an event that has not started yet is unknowable now but will resolve later. That is not the same as a
date that never exists, nor as one that exists only on MCP, nor as one resting on an assumption.

UObjectToolTips.FortCharacterDynamicsComponentInterface:
class UFortCharacterDynamicsComponentInterface

Provides an abstract interface for the UFortCharacterDynamicsComponent Actor Component that excludes any
references to structures defined in FortniteGame (specifically AnimInstances etc). This class exists purely
to solve dependency problems and allow features of the Character Dynamics Control plugin to be accessed by
FortniteGame code and assets.

This class uses a pure non-virtual interface to work around the limitations of UFunction declarations
(they can't be virtual).
